title: HP Knocks it Out of the Park
text: I have been in dire need of a new computer for a LONG time. My laptop is about five years old and takes about 10 to 15 minutes just to power up completely. I already have the use of a laptop from my workplace, so I don’t really need a replacement for it. What I need is a desktop computer to use when my laptop is still at work and this need was enough to convince me to get the HP Pavilion 24-inch All-in-One Computer, Intel Core i5-9400T, 12 GB RAM, 512 GB Solid State Drive with Windows 10. Taken out of the box, consumers will of course need to set this computer up and get it ready. I am happy to say that the set up is about as simple as it could possibly be- much simpler than the set up of other pc’s I have owned, which shows just how long it has been since I have gotten a new computer. In under 10 minutes, it was ready to use. It was so easy, I started to worry that I had forgotten something, but everything was good to go. This computer comes with a nice size screen- about 24 inches- which is the largest I have ever had in my house. It does make it easier to see things and I like watching videos and movies- something I didn’t like as much on my laptop, which had a screen about half as wide. The resolution and colors are good, too. I watched a few online videos and was impressed by how vibrant the different colors looked and how life- like people and faces appeared. Having a touch screen is cool and this is something new for me. I have never owned a touch screen computer before and while I like and support new technology, I admit that this is taking time to get used to. I still prefer to use my mouse out of habit, but this will likely change in due time. It really is much easier to simply touch a screen and it makes navigation faster. About the only issue I have with this computer is the fees charged for Microsoft Office. You get a free trial period, but after that, you will have to pay for the service. Considering the price of this computer, Microsoft Office should be part of the deal. I get that these companies need a regular revenue stream and charging for services was bound to happen but I still think it should have been an exception with this computer, given its higher than average cost. Getting rid of my laptop is a great relief. With my HP Pavilion 24-inch All-in-One Computer, Intel Core i5-9400T, 12 GB RAM, 512 GB Solid State Drive with Windows 10 computer, my power up time has been reduced to under one minute and I have a viewable screen that is much more vibrant than before. I’m still a little irritated with the whole Microsoft Office thing, but it’s not enough to lower my rating, which is an easy five stars for this excellent HP product.

title: Lightweight and Gets the Job Done
text: With the preponderance of electronics most everyone needs to have something to transport them in. Laptops are owned by almost every adult and they continue to shrink in size and weight, making it more convenient to move them from one place to the next. I have two laptops and need to carry them around, whether to work and back, during travel, etc. And my new constant companion for this purpose is the Fit & Fresh Laptop Backpack. Light in construction and utilitarian in design, this laptop bag easily fits most 15.6” Laptops or smaller. There are two large compartments on the inside. The back compartment has more padding and thus is best for placing your laptop, although you could also put your laptop in the front section. The back section also has a Velcro strap, to help hold your laptop in place. There is sufficient space either way. You could even store two laptops or tablets, thanks to the double compartments. With storage space, there is an ample number of pockets to satisfy most needs. The front compartment even has a zipped mesh- style storage space and there is a zipped pocket on the outside, too. With so many pockets, you can store your pens, mouse, and other items with ease. And the black color gives the backpack a professional look so it is good for just about any purpose. For carrying, the Fit & Fresh Laptop Backpack presents three options. There are straps on the back so that you can wear this bag, like a backpack. But there is also a set of handles- one on the top and one on the side so that you can carry it around if you prefer. Having the two handles is cool because it means you can carry it vertically or horizontally, whichever is most suitable for you. I don’t necessarily like carrying on my back but I do like the metal handle for carrying it vertically. My laptop and contents are light enough that I can carry with ease. I like what I have experienced with this laptop backpack and it fulfills what I need from this type of item. About the only small issue some people may have is with the backpack’s flimsiness. This is not a heavy- duty bag and because of this, it may not be suitable for everyone. I have another laptop bag that is thicker and more durable that I use when I need more toughness. This laptop backpack is most useful when I need a simple way to pack up my laptop and accessories and head to work or to school. That is really what it was intended for. With so many electronic devices, we need ways to safely get them from place to place and the Fit & Fresh Laptop Backpack is good for this purpose. One word of caution before you buy is to measure your laptop and make sure it will fit into this bag, before you make the purchase. Some laptops are too large for this bag. My laptop is small and fits with no problem. If it fits, then I recommend this backpack for your daily electronics transporting needs. It fulfills its task and the price is right.

title: Good for Securing Your Home
text: Most of the places I have lived have been reasonably safe, so I have never felt any pressing need to add a camera security system to my home. I already have an alarm system, which is useful, but no camera system. I decided that it would be good to be able to see people at the main entrances to my home/property and this convinced me to add the Arlo Ultra - 4K UHD Wire-Free Security 2 Camera System to my house. Setting this security system up is simple enough. You have to mount the included 2 cameras and it doesn’t take much time to complete this step. I placed one of them by my front door and the other one just outside my garage, facing the driveway. The gated entrance to my backyard is right there, and I usually leave my car in the driveway and not the garage, so this seemed like a good place. There are many things to like about this security camera system, like the wide angle of view that is good for seeing from my backyard gate to the end of my driveway. You can even speak back and forth with someone at your front door and this can prove useful when you want to avoid talking directly, face to face, with solicitors. With the image quality, although it isn’t as sharp as I expected, it seems sufficient to me. I haven’t experienced any intruders thus far- knock on wood- so I haven’t necessarily needed to get crystal clear details. One limitation I have is that I haven’t owned a camera security system before. This is a first for me, so I don’t have any point of comparison. Still, the picture quality seems good. And I like the notification system. Any motion detection is set up to record, so you can see what is going on and you know quickly. The app itself is user- friendly enough but one thing to keep in mind is that the Arlo Smart Servive and cloud recording are free for only the first year. After that, you have to pay for a subscription. I will wait to see if the system is worth my while, then decide whether to subscribe. A year of free usage time should be sufficient to make the call. Security is important and the Arlo Ultra - 4K UHD Wire-Free Security 2 Camera System is a good way to keep safe. Two cameras are definitely better than one because I am able to secure the two areas of my property where an unwanted individual is most likely to show up. I find the app and picture quality good and the system as a whole has enough positive points to recommend.

title: Good Sound Quality and Lightweight
text: I’m never been a huge fan of headphones. I recognize their value and necessity when you want to listen to something but no one around you does. The reason I don’t like headphones is the bulkiness and wires but Soundcore Anker Liberty Air True Wireless Earphones with Charging Case have eliminated these issues. These earphones come in a small case and they are extremely lightweight. You simply remove them from the package, connect via Bluetooth, insert in the ears, and start listening to your favorite tunes. There are no wires so you can move around as you please and because they are so small, you don’t have the bulkiness. Many people, unless they take a close look at you, will not even know that you are using earphones. Of course, what matters most with something like this is the sound quality and these earphones score above average marks for sound. The bass is especially good and I like that I can pause, skip music, take calls, etc with a simple push of the touchpads. And to charge, you just place them back into the case. They claim to last up to 20 hours on a charge, but I haven’t come even close to using them for that much time, so I cannot verify the claim. Soundcore Amker Liberty True Wireless Earphones do not provide any way to control the volume using touch controls, so this is one issue I have with them. But other than that, these are very good earphones and certainly worth a try

title: Very Good Starter Camcorder
text: My two girls love their electronics. Mom and dad love them too, so we can’t really fault the two pre- teens from using and enjoying their electronics to the fullest. We like it best when they are at least devoting some of their electronic time to doing things more constructive and/or creative, and this is what convinced me to get my hands on this SOSUN Camcorder. I had not heard of SOSUN until I got this camcorder, but I had read good things about the brand and decided that such a large percentage of customers must be right about something. One of my girls wanted a camcorder and this one seemed to have what she needed and seemed good for a beginner. The camera is lightweight and easy to hold. It can be used for regular picture taking and for video. The quality of video produced is good, too. There are better camcorders out there that create better videos and have more features, but this one is still good for a beginner like my 13 year old. The battery life on this camcorder is about 2 hours. Given my kid’s short attention span, this is more than enough to keep her happy. In fact, she typically creates videos that are only two to five minutes in length. Unless her habits change, the 2 hour battery life is more than sufficient. Camcorders can get expensive , especially if your needs and demands are high. But if you’re looking for a good starter camcorder for a very low price, this SOSUN is going to be difficult to match. The low price and above average quality make it worth the purchase and my increasingly more creative middle school age kid can vouch for its worthiness.

title: Good for Google Users Like Me
text: Electronics are a fact of life and most families have multiple electronic devices to get through their day. My family of four has four cell phones, about six different pcs, laptops, and tablets, and three printers. Now, we also have our first ever Chromebook thanks to this Amazon product. Chromebooks, I quickly learned, differ from the usual windows or apple laptop in several important ways and chief among them is the limit on the number of things you can download. If you have specific games and other things you want to download, they may not work. I already knew this going in but I can tell from reading other reviews that some people were not aware that it worked this way and they now have a device with limited usefulness. Once you accept the Acer Chromebook for what it is, you will find that it does serve as a handy device. It’s excellent for browsing the internet, creating google docs, using google apps, and pretty much doing all things google. I am already a google chrome user when I go online and I already use many apps from the google play, so what this Chromebook offers is compatible with my needs. Looking at other specifics of this Acer Chromebook, it is about the same size as my old laptop, at least in terms of the screen size. The image is good, although I have seen other laptops/tablets with more pixels and sharper images. Still, it should be sufficient for most needs, and it has a good deal to offer for the price. I have noticed that the charge doesn’t hold as long as the manufacturer claims and the bottom of the Chromebook does feel hot a little sooner than with others. But the Acer Chromebook is still functional and it performs well enough for my needs. Electronics are a fact of life and as much as we try to limit their use, they are here to stay. Since we have to have them and use them, it makes sense to get the electronics that best suit our needs for a fair price and this Acer Chromebook does exactly that. It does have its limits and it cannot do everything that a windows or apple laptop can do, but as long as you know the limitations before you purchase, you should be fine.

title: Good for Your Bedroom Nightstand
text: In the age of electronics, we all need more ways to plug ourselves in and manufacturers know this. They have responded by added usb ports and regular outlets to everyday appliances and this added convenience was enough to convince me to get the Seealle Bedside Desk Lamp with USB Fast Charging Port and Outlets Power Strip. This lamp requires a small amount of assembly out of the box. The assembly is simple, but it takes longer than it should due to the way they pack everything into the box. I know they do this to require as little space and as small of a box as possible, but the way the shade is inverted with the base stuck inside it takes effort to get loose. I was extra careful and avoided damage, but many people will not be so lucky. Once assembled, you just need to screw in a light bulb, screw the shade in place, and set the lamp on your desired table. My wife needed a night light for evening book reading, so I placed the lamp on her night stand. She likes having two places to plug in her phone, and the added light is nice for reading. There is a master switch on the cord and this provides another way to turn everything on and off, including the outlets. Another switch on the side of the base also controls the outlet. This is why, when you plug something in, you need to check to make sure it is charging. If it isn’t, then there is a good chance that one of the switches is in the off position. The light can be turned on/off using either the switch on the cord or by pulling the vertical, hanging metal cord underneath the light bulb. This small light looks good on a night stand, but it is slightly smaller than expected. It also seems rather delicate and due to the darkness of the shade, it may not produce the level of light you need. I find it fine as a bedroom nightlight because we don’t want it to be bright in this type of setting anyway, but other people might find that the shade makes everything too dark. It’s always good to have extra outlets and lamps with added outlets are commonplace nowadays as manufacturers answer customer needs. I like that this light has two added outlets, but the lamp is small and I still cannot get over the effort it took to dislodge the inverted shade from the base when I pulled the lamp out of the box for the first time. So, when all factors are taken into account, this lamp rates as average overall.

title: Much More than Your Standard Power Strip
text: Electronics have become a regular part of life. There is really no sense in resisting- electronics are here to stay and most would agree, even if they have slight reservations, that electronics have improved our lives overall. These electronic devices need to be continuously recharged and an excellent tool for the job is this Kasa Smart Wifi Power Strip. This power strip is intended to charge lots of electronics at once. It has six standard outlets and three USB outlets. That means you can charge up to nine devices at once, making this a very useful and popular item to take with you at your next conference. You will find that people around you will ask to plug themselves in and you will have no trouble obliging. It has surge protection, too, so that your electronics stay safe. What sets this power strip apart, however, is its high tech personality. It can be controlled remotely using the Kasa app and you can see exactly how much power each item is using, then shut off individual outlets if you like, all from the app! And if you have Google Assistant, Alexa, or Microsoft Cortana, you can use voice commands to control the outlets. That means being able to turn on and off, say, a light that is plugged into the strip with a simple utterance. It’s a geek’s power strip dream come true. I plan to use it on my holiday lights when the season comes around- it will be much easier then climbing behind the tree to manually turn the lights on and off. Kasa Smart Wifi Power Strip is a heavy- duty power strip that seems like it was made to last. The plug on the strip does require a three prong outlet to plug it in, so make sure you can accommodate before you buy. It has all of the things you would want in an app controlled, voice activated power strip and it receives my highest recommendation.

title: Backpack and Luggage in One
text: I travel quite a bit and many of the trips I take are short in duration- often only two or three nights. I don’t need a lot of luggage space for these short trips and I like taking backpacks because I can often avoid carry- on and baggage fees if my backpack can fit under my seat. This desire for economical travel led me to get the Case Logic BRYBPR116 Bryker Backpack Roller. With this Case Logic Backpack, you get a two-in-one backpack and piece of luggage well suited for travel or business. The wheels make it perfect for traversing an airport and with the added straps, you can carry it on your back, like a traditional backpack. There is an outside pocket where you can tuck the straps so they are not hanging out, flopping around when you don’t need them. And the handle can be completely pushed inside the backpack and sealed off with a zipper so that no one sees it. I like these qualities because it means I can make this look like a backpack when I want it to and I can make it look more like a piece of luggage when I want it to. Inside the backpack, there is a separate compartment for a laptop and I like that you can unsnap this if you like, making for a larger interior space that is just right for stuffing your two- day supply of clothing and personal items. Like I said, my primary usage with this backpack is for travel and I usually don’t take my laptop with me when I’m on a two- day trip, so I would rather have the open space, to make it more like a piece of luggage. There is one thing to keep in mind if you take this backpack on a plane, and that is the size of pack makes it only barely able to fit under your seat. It will stick out some, so be prepared to have a snug space where your feet normally go. And unlike other backpacks, it’s too rigid- thanks to the handle- to make it collapsible and flexible. To save having to pay carry- on fees on certain airlines, I am willing to place it under the airline seat in front of me regardless, even if it does stick out some. If your flying on an airline that doesn’t charge extra for carry-ons, then this won’t be an issue since you can easily place the backpack in the overhead, which is what I recommend doing. For everyone else, just bear in mind that the length of the backpack makes it a challenge to fit under a seat. I have a wide assortment of backpacks and luggage in my home to accommodate different needs. This Case Logic rolling backpack is a nice addition to my collection and I like that it performs a dual role. It has suited me well so far and it makes a good choice of luggage/backpack for business people and others who are constantly on the go for short spans of time.

title: Useful for Business, School, and Travel
text: As much as we travel in my household, we need an assortment of luggage, backpacks, and other user- friendly containers. We have several different pieces and that’s great because it means there is always an appropriate bag for the trip at hand. But one area my household lacks a little is with smaller bags and that is what convinced me to add the Solo Gramercy Rolling Case Laptop Bag to my collection. First and probably foremost, this bag is made to hold a laptop computer and it has a separate compartment for it. I like that the laptop compartment is quickly accessible because it means that, if you take this to an airport, you can quickly remove the laptop, as you are required to do. But this is much more than a place to store your laptop computer. It is also good for carrying books, brochures, and other paper items, with large and small compartments to keep everything organized. I sometimes take very short trips that don’t require much clothing or grooming items and I was concerned at first that this bag wasn’t designed correctly to hold such items. But in fact, it is, provided that you don’t have much. As a man, I normally don’t need to take much with me anyway and I have found that I can fit what I need for a day’s change in clothing, plus my personal grooming items, plus my laptop, all within the confines of this bag. It won’t hold much more than that, so don’t think of using this as your sole piece of luggage for a multi- day trip. There isn’t sufficient storage space in that instance, but you can get away with using it for a one or two day trip. To help maneuver, this laptop bag has four spinner- style wheels and a telescopic handle. This makes it ideal to drag along when you’re at an airport, but I should also point out that this bag is useful even if you have no need or limited need to use it during air travel. It’s also very useful when you need to carry your laptop and school or business books and documents from place to place. It’s better than a traditional briefcase because it has more ways to organize your items. We like and need an assortment of bags in my household because we never know where we will travel next and what we will need. The Solo Gramercy Rolling Case Laptop Bag is a useful storage bag for airport or other uses and it has made an excellent addition to our collection thus far, as it has come in handy for both travel and business uses.

title: Acer Aspire: Everything We Want in a Computer
text: Computers are an important part of life. I know, I know- we need to get away from electronics and try to return to the days when more personal interactions were the norm. But regardless of how you feel about the proliferation of electronics in everyday living, there is no denying that most of us need them to one degree or another. We are writers/bloggers in my home and need good machines to carry us through the day. And the Acer Aspire Touch Desktop is one excellent machine for everyday use. Let’s start with the physical attributes. This Acer computer features a very large flat screen with excellent clarity, making it ideal for watching videos, television shows, etc. The keyboard and mouse are wireless, so there is no issue over wires getting tangled as you work. Best of all, the CPU is part of the monitor. There is no separate tower or other computing unit, and that means this computer is space efficient. All you need is a place wide enough to handle the width of the monitor. The keyboard is certainly different from the one I was using previously and it took some adjusting to get used to. But this is the case with any new keyboard and you know what?- the adjustment period for this keyboard was less than a day. In almost no time at all, my wife and I took to the change and had no further issues. As for the set up, well, it doesn’t get much better than this. I can remember when it would take several hours and much frustration to set up a new computer. But with Acer Aspire, the set up was complete and the computer was ready to use in less than 10 minutes after removing it from the box! We actually scheduled some time in our day, thinking it was going to require a fair amount of time to complete everything. It was so fast I started to worry that I did something wrong. But that wasn’t the case- everything is pretty much ready to go, straight from the package. Because of our writing and blogging, we often need to have multiple windows open at any given time. This was an issue with my wife’s laptop and it would often slow her computer to a crawl. With this Acer computer, there is no such problem. She can have ten separate windows open, along with Microsoft Word and Excel, and the speed is still as good as ever. Again, this is a definite plus, as computer speed is a top concern for us and many other computer users. I always try to find something that needs improvement when I write a product review but with the Acer Aspire, I can think of only one thing, and it relates to the Office Suite. They give you Office Suite for a free trial but once the trial is up, you will have to purchase it yourself. Acer could easily make this improvement and while this type of criticism has really nothing to do with the functionality of the product itself, it is about the only issue I can find. Everything else about this computer is well above average. Computers are essential to my household. We need our computers for writing, for the classes I teach, and other uses. With the Acer Aspire Touch Desktop, we have found a cutting- edge computing machine that fits our needs perfectly and has everything we desire. It’s an excellent computer that would look really good on your desktop and I recommend it when it comes time for your next pc upgrade.

title: Great for My Kid's Tech Table
text: More electronics in the home means a need for more outlets. An ordinary extension cord will do the trick, but if you want something that looks nicer, has more functionality, and protects against power surges than one good option is the APC P11U2 APC Surge Arrest. This surge protection device is great for those who need extra outlets for plugging in electronics and other things. It has eleven sockets plus 2 USB ports for a total of 13 places to plug things in and keep them running. An indicator light will tell you if there is an overload, which is highly possible when there are so any plugs. We don’t have this problem because we use this on our kid’s tech table. It allows them to plug in their cell phones, tablets, kindles, and other items- all which use minimal power- and get everything charged all at once without them fighting over limited outlet availability. Each of the outlets on this surge protector has a safety closure, which is good for keeping out unwanted items. This can be useful if you have young children- wouldn’t want junior sticking a paper clip or other item inside one of the sockets. And a light glows to indicate that the surge protection is working as it should. If I could change one thing about this, it would be the length of the cord. It would be better if it was just a little longer because it would be capable of reaching further. But other than that, this surge protector has worked just fine for my needs. It has ample space to plug in and charge all of our household electronics, keeping them ready for use and protecting against power spikes in the process.

title: Dell Inspiron 13 7000 Series: Updated Technology has Won Me Over
text: Looking for a quality laptop at a fair price? Then one you might want to consider is the Dell Inspiron 7000 Series. This laptop computer offers the latest in technological improvements for an all- around user- friendly experience. I have owned many Dell products over the years and have generally had good success with them. This Dell laptop impresses from the start, first with its attractive, modern design. It looks and feels the way a top- of- the- line computer should look and feel, with a lightweight composition and sleek appearance. Second, this Dell product is extremely easy to set up. A person needs no computer skill whatsoever to prepare this laptop for use. You just answer a few simple questions, link and e-mail account if you like, set up a user name, etc., and presto- you are logged in and ready to connect your wifi for home usage. As for its usefulness, this Dell computer scores well in most areas. One of my kids likes to use it and she was immediately impressed by the fact that the hinges allow the screen to be folded backward, flush with the base, for a tablet- like arrangement. She likes to use the computer to play games, so she liked this capability. The images are very clear, too, better than those I have on my previous laptop, which was an HP model a couple of years old. One of the key features of this laptop is its touchscreen capabilities. I must admit, I was a little skeptical about this feature for a few reasons. First, I was concerned that it wouldn’t work the way it should and second, I didn’t know if I would take to the new technology. I normally adapt to change quickly, but touching a computer screen when I could easily use the built in mouse control? I just wasn’t sure this would work for me. But now that I have used it, I like the touch screen feature. I use it more than expected and have now abandoned the use of the mouse, in most circumstances. The only slight issue I have had is with the tendency of the touch screen to not always react immediately. Sometimes, it requires a second touch for the command to accept. Other than that, it seems to work well. Dell Inspiron 7000 Series has a 13 inch screen which is just slightly smaller than that of my previous laptop. The speed of this laptop is better, however, and it quickly moves from one web site to the next without much trouble. It’s a very good laptop for the price and it’s one I recommend.

title: Monitor Your Home or Office with Ease but try to Ignore the Wires
text: Q- see 12 camera security system is a nice way to protect a home or business from threats. Install the cameras in different sections of the home or company and then access from home, online, etc. for top level security. This security system seems much more complicated than it really is and the reason, I think, is due to the number of cameras. Looking at all of those cameras, out of the box, is a little bit intimidating and it leads one to believe that setup will take days and even weeks to complete. But it is actually much simpler than it looks and there is no need to install all 12. Just use the number of cameras you feel is necessary and store the rest for later use. With this security system in place, you can access the live feed through the internet and even on your mobile phone via the Q- See applications. This is great for convenience and its one of the security systems best features. Other security systems have this feature as well, so it’s nothing unique. But it is very easy to use and it lets you monitor specific places on a property, for maximum security. Wherever you might be, home or away, you can take a look at what’s going on by pulling the mobile phone from your pocket. It doesn’t get much easier than that. The one issue I have with this system is the same one others have complained about, and that is the wires. In the modern world in which we live, we expect wireless technology more and more. This system is wired and it could present some problems as you try to tape wires and otherwise conceal them from view. If this was a wireless system and I could place the cameras anyplace I like, then I would be hard pressed to find much wrong with this product. But I know many people who would likely reject this product immediately for this reason alone. Security is important, especially for those who live in less safe areas or who operate a small business in a vulnerable area. With Q- See watching the home or business, you can feel a little more at ease. The cameras detect motion and can quickly help you catch a person in the act of theft, trespassing, or vandalism, providing proof positive of what happened and where. Like I said, the lack of wireless technology is a problem but if you can get past that issue, you will find that this is a very good security system for home or business needs.

title: It's Small, but it Makes a Big Difference
text: When listening to your favorite tunes, videos, etc., sound enhancement makes a noticeable difference. Cell phones and other electronic devices are often quite lacking in sound quality, mainly because the sounds are directed to a tiny speaker. An enhancement can make music and other noises come to life and the Xboom Mini Portable Capsule Speaker is ready to serve in this regard. This speaker is small, stylish, and versatile and I have used it with several different electronic devices. It is very compact in size, operates on a rechargeable battery, and can be collapsed to a size so small that it fits into tight quarters with ease. Just plug it into a cell phone, tablet, or other device, flip the switch, adjust the volume, and listen to your favorite music like never before. I was skeptical when I first used this device because it just didn’t seem capable of much. It looks cool, but it’s just so small. How much sound could possibly release itself from such a tiny speaker, I wondered. But a few uses demonstrate that this little speaker is capable of many great things. It doesn’t produces deafening decibels, no. But the volume is much louder than that of a typical cell phone or tablet. And the bass enhancement makes it sound like a true stereo speaker. I was pleasantly surprised when I used it and I couldn’t believe something so seemingly miniscule and insignificant would be capable of so much. The battery in this little guy is good for about 12 hours of use, according to the manufacturer. Truth is, I have never had to worry about this because, if you use the USB cord and plug into a computer, you don’t need to charge it first. My kids like to use it in their cell phones and they are always careful to maintain the charge. Twelve hours is a long time and the reason I know it’s a long time is because, in a few months of use, it has never exhausted its charge. The kiddos can use it on a lengthy road trip and it maintains its juice. Many smaller electronics need better sound and the Xboom Mini Portable Capsule Speaker is a very good device for improving your next audio experience. Multiple units can be plugged together for even greater satisfaction but even if you have only one, you will find this little gadget is more than able to deliver very good sound quality. It’s one of my favorite electronic enhancers and one I and my kids will continue to use.

title: A Good DVD Player for Those With Limited Needs
text: Portable DVD players have their use and the Verezano Portable DVD Player is a decent one for general needs. With a nine inch screen area, stereo speakers, and a swivel screen, it’s a good DVD player for children and others and it’s nice to have when on vacation or in other situations when the kids need some electronic entertainment. We use portable DVD players in my household mostly for child entertainment so I often base buying decisions and reviews from that perspective. This portable DVD player does seem to have the minimum requirements to keep the kids happy and occupied. It is made mostly from plastic and is lightweight. And kids love the swivel screen. I have had to step in a few times and calm them down, as they love grabbing the screen and twisting it back and forth. I find the functions on this portable DVD player simple to use and my kids had no trouble picking up on the operations. I did notice, however, that the remote control does not always make the unit respond. I often have to grab it and point more directly at the unit to get it to accept my command and even then, it takes a couple of pushes before anything happens. It isn’t a battery issue, as it does this even when the batteries are fresh. Speaking of batteries, probably my greatest problem with this Verezano DVD player is the battery life in the unit itself. A charge is good for only about 2 hours, and that means it will die out after a one full movie is watched and sometimes even sooner. This means a long road trip in the car or flight on a plane will be too much. The unit will die out and have to be recharged long before your destination is reached. So, judging this product from different angles, it seems to have the adequate properties to make it a worthwhile purchase for those with limited needs. My kids really like the swivel screen and they quickly figured out how to make it the player operate. But the battery life and issues with the remote control convince me to lower my rating to 3 stars. You basically get what you pay for, and that means a very average product.

title: Is This Really Necessary?
text: Notebook computers can overheat. It isn't a worry when you use your computer sparingly, but it can become a problem with extended usage. This cooling pad was designed to solve the problem by circulating air via two small fans with the power supplied by your notebook's USB. The movement of air is, supposedly, enough to keep your notebook from overheating or at least lessen the chances. A product like this certainly sounds like a good idea and a practical solution to a problem, but does it really work as promised? Well, it does cause some extra flow of air, as expected, but the cooling effects are minimal. The main reason is because the flow of air is so light. Turn on the fans and place your hand next to them. You will barely feel anything and this is reason enough to suspect that it makes little difference. Another thing to keep in mind with this cooling pad is that it will not work if you do not set it up properly. It has to be standing on a flat surface so that the air can flow underneath. If you're the type who holds your notebook on your lap, then a product like this will not work for you. There has to be space underneath so that the fans can operate and get the air moving. The Mac Cooling Pad does fit securely on Mac's of different sizes and can be used for non- Mac pc's as well. I suppose it could make some difference in temperature, but it seems like a novelty product to me. Unless you are already experiencing an overheated notebook, a product like this is a waste of money.

title: A Simple Means for Security
text: Bell & Howell's Wireless Video Door Intercom System is a simple system that can be used to communicate directly with someone outside your front door. The device is not just an intercom system- it also presents a video image of the person at the door, for better security. This device pretty much works as it promises to work and it is basically a walkie- talkie with a video screen. One has to press the button to talk and, likewise, the person at the front door has to press the button to respond. The two- way communication has to be initiated on both ends for the device to work the way it should. You can still view the person at the door regardless, but for them to respond to your questions, they have to press the button. Don't be surprised if you have to instruct the person at the door to press the button before they speak. Most will not know this and will start to answer questions that cannot be heard on the other end until the button is pressed. Besides the manual operation mentioned above, another issue I have with this system is the video quality. Now, I realize that the product is a simple one, but for the price, I expect a little clearer and more accurate image. It appears I am not alone with this complaint- many other consumers have said the same thing. You can easily tell who is at the door, but the video quality does not display the colors very well. Security is nice and this Bell & Howell intercom system does provide some security and ability to tell who is standing at the front door before you turn the knob. It is overpriced for what you get, but it is easy enough to use and it does offer wireless operation, making it a decent choice for some consumers.

title: Thule Gauntlet MacBook Air Sleeve Protecs Your Investment
text: Electronic devices need protection. Considering the money invested in their purchase, all electronics could use some protection, but this fact is even truer for laptops because they cost more. The Thule Case Logic Gauntlet is specifically made for this purpose and it is just large enough to hold your Macbook Air and keep it safe. The Thule Case Logic Gauntlet Air Sleeve is nothing more than a simple case/sleeve to hold your Macbook and certain other electronics and it is designed to seal out water and keep the inner contents safe from the elements. The foam construction is tough enough to cushion any blow and the vinyl lining on the inside is nice because it makes your electronic investment slide in and out with ease. From a construction standpoint, the sleeve is a good one and I feel confident knowing my electronic device is safe from harm. One thing to keep in mind with this sleeve is that it has no additional pockets for storage. It is truly nothing more than a sleeve and while this fact should be obvious, many might purchase this expecting it to be more like a laptop bag with extra compartments. With this protector, you get nothing more than a place to insert your Mac and a Velcro- fastened flap to seal the deal. Another thing to think about is the size. This sleeve is intended to hold a 13 inch Mac tightly and securely. You can use it for other things, like regular pc's, but if they are any larger, there is a good chance they will not fit inside. Electronics and other devices are costly and they need to be protected from bumps, drops, and weather. With the Thule Case Logic Gauntlet, you get a good sleeve for exactly that and while I agree that the price is somewhat high, this is a stylish sleeve and it does a good job protecting your Mac or other electronics from harm.

title: Tango Bar Improves the Audio Experience
text: When listening to music, a good sound system can make a huge difference and it is known fact that the built in speakers on an iMac, while good, are not the greatest at producing a high quality level of sound. This is where the Tango Bar can make a difference. It attaches quickly to your iMac, creating a sound experience that is far better than before. First, let's look at the appearance. This speaker is nothing more than a rectangular bar and is thus very utilitarian. It isn't going to win any awards for style because it is very ordinary looks- wise. But with its aluminum construction, it does match the appearance of an iMac and thus, when hooked up, it looks right at home. The Tango Bar includes an auxiliary jack for input, a connector for a subwoofer, and a headphone jack. The sound quality from the device is actually quite good even if a little lacking in bass. The sound is similar in quality to a low- wattage boom box with the bass turned low. There isn't a huge volume of sound with this speaker, but it should be fine for its intended use. Audio quality can make all the difference when listening to music or other sounds from your iMac and the Tango Bar does offer a noticeable improvement compared to the sound from the built in iMac speakers. Its metal construction means the speaker is made to last and while it could use a few improvements, it is still a good option for iMac users who want to enhance the audio experience.

title: One of the Best Headsets Around
text: Corsair 1100 Gaming Headset is a very nice headset with many good reasons to consider it for purchase. It is manufactured by a company known for its quality headsets and this latest model is every bit as good as many from Corsair's past. Taking a close look at this headset, the first positive aspect is the appearance. It is very modern, slick, and cool- the type that most anyone would not mind wearing, just because it looks so good. The comfort level is very good too, with just the right amount of cushioning and lightweight design. Most important to many is the sound quality and what you get with this Corsair headset is excellent. The sound is crisp, clear, and among the best I have ever used. No matter what type of sound is flowing through the wires, it enters your ears sounding the way it should, without any fuzziness or interference. Even when you try different sounds, music, etc., it still sounds excellent. Most products have at least one potential flaw but with this Corsair headset, I am hard- pressed to find any thing wrong or anything I would change. Okay, it would be nice if it was priced a little lower, but with quality like this- both in comfort and in the sound- a few extra dollars is certainly money well invested.

title: Good Protective Cover and Stand for your Apple iPad2
text: The Targus VuScape Protective cover and stand is a pretty good, helpful aid for those who own an Apple Ipad2. It features a thin, lightweight design that is meant to hold the iPad2 snugly in place while you work. Having a stand for your iPad is certainly a good idea and I like that this stand can be used to position your iPad in different ways. There are multiple grooves so that you can display your iPad at different angles. The cover can also be folded back completely, allowing the consumer to hold the iPad in the hands without the stand. This protective cover/stand does have some nice features to offer, but after using it for a while, it is more than apparent that the stand is not perfect. Probably the greatest issue is that the stand isn't as sturdy as I would prefer. If you use the stand on a solid, flat surface, you shouldn't have too many problems, but place it on other surfaces and it tends to bend just a little bit. The slightest bend will cause the grooves to give way just a little, and the iPad will no longer be securely held in place. I generally like the thin, lightweight design of this stand, but the thinness possibly goes a tad far. If the manufacturer had made this stand just a little bit thicker, it would be stronger and more likely to hold the iPad in place without any problems. I suppose this is the trade- off one must make when selecting a stand such as this. Lightweight is nice, especially for something like an iPad, but lightweight means the stand is lacking in strength. All in all, this is a good stand and certainly worth considering, but not a deluxe stand like I expected. Again, as long as you are willing to sacrifice sturdiness for lightweight design, you should be fine. And try to use only on the flattest surfaces for the best results. Follow these guidelines and you should find yourself reasonably happy with this protective cover and stand from Targus.

title: Philips GoGear Vibe: Nothing Special, but Good for the Price
text: Philips GoGear Vibe 8 GB MP3 Player is a reasonably priced MP3 player from Philips Electronics. Small and with a good deal of memory, this MP3 player offers enough of the basic features to satisfy casual MP3 users' needs. Let's talk about the good points first. This MP3 player is a good value and it has a long battery life. A full charge can last the better part of a day so it is ready when you need it. The compact size and durable construction are also plusses with this MP3 player. It takes up very little space and the metal construction is made to last. I like the menu navigation as well and found it very intuitive. Most important to an MP3 player is sound quality and in this area, my feelings are mixed. My MP3 player experience is limited, so I have little to which I can compare. But based on other MP3 players, the sound quality with this Phillips device is a little below average. I was also very disappointed with the Full Sound option. This is supposed to improve the sound quality, but I could barely tell any difference. It has a little too much bass for my tastes, but others might find it acceptable. Probably my greatest complaint with this Philips MP3 player is the included ear buds. They are the type that hugs the ear, but they do not contain a foam cushion and thus are not very comfortable or very good at blocking outside noise. The good thing, of course, is that an accessory like this can be replaced, which I recommend doing if you purchase this product. MP3 players are nice and Philips GoGear Vibe 8 GB MP3 Player is a good MP3 player, especially for the price. There are certainly better MP3 players out there, but this is a good one for beginners or those with basic needs. I'm torn with my overall rating because of the division between the pros and cons. So, I will award this device with a middle rating of three stars and a modest recommendation.

title: Simple Intercom Unit for Basic Needs
text: The Defender GK300- 7M2 Hands Free 2- wire color video intercom system is a relatively inexpensive intercom system designed to provide peace of mind with minimum hassle. This device is simple enough to install and is instantly ready to use with the flick of a switch. Besides the simple setup, this monitor has some other interesting features that make it useful. I really like the night vision option because it makes visible what would otherwise be difficult to make out. I like the sound- it is easy to tell exactly what is being said- and I like the loud, easily noticeable chime when someone rings the doorbell. The fifty- foot cable is also nice because it is long enough that I was able to place the viewing monitor in my bedroom with no problem. As for the cons, I can find a few. The video quality isn't the greatest- it is a little fuzzy, even though I can still tell who is on the screen. Then, there is the duration of the video- it displays for only about thirty to thirty- five seconds. After that, the screen goes blank and you have to keep pressing the video button to get it back. This latter feature is one I wish was different. Often, you will want to watch and listen to the person at the door, but because you have to remember to keep pressing the video button, you could easily miss something important. This is a basic intercom unit, hence the average quality overall. I know there are more sophisticated products on the market, but they all cost several times more than this, the Defender GK300- 7M2 intercom. I suppose for the price, it is an acceptable option but don't buy this expecting a fancy, high tech intercom unit. All you get with this are the basics, making it good enough for only for those with minimal security needs.

title: Cool Digital Camera for Beginners
text: Nikon Coolpix S220 Digital Camera is a compact digital camera that makes a good camera choice for the first- time digital camera owner who is ready to get started in the world of digital photography but wants something that isn't priced too high or requires too much tech savvy. It is one of the smaller cameras available and it is offered at a price level that makes it ideal for the budget- minded consumer. Digital cameras are offered in many sizes and with many features and the Nikon Coolpix S220 Digital Camera is easily the smallest digital camera I have ever used. There are some cameras that are even smaller, but most are inadequate for my needs, due to their often tiny LCD viewing screen. This camera offers an LCD screen that is large enough to easily see what you need to see so that picture taking is optimized. The size is sufficient enough that it doesn't hinder the taking of quality pictures. Picture quality is the most important feature of any digital camera and the Nikon Coolpix S220 Digital Camera does, indeed, take good pictures for a simpler camera. It also includes helpful features that produce better photographs, such as its image stabilization system. I also like the color options. Standard color is the option most photographers will use, but there is also a setting called Vivid Color. This option brightens the colors and in many ways, it reminds me of the colors common to a videotaped television program. However, one needs to be careful with this feature because I have found that it sometimes distorts the colors in certain situations. For example, outdoor pictures should not be taken using the Vivid Color option because it can result in a level of color that is a little unrealistic. Another picture taking aid with this camera is its Smart Portrait system. This includes features such as Smile Mode, which automatically snaps the picture when the subject is smiling; Built- in blink proofing, which snaps two pictures and deletes one of them if eyes are blinking; Face- Priority technology, which focuses quickly on faces and adjusts brightness so that faces look more natural; etc. These features are nice, but not always reliable. I have found, for example, that the blink- prevention feature doesn't always work. Sometimes, pictures get snapped anyway with the eyes of the subject shut. Of course, one can easily delete the picture and try again, but it would be nice if this technology was more predictable. The Nikon Coolpix S220 Digital Camera is a small digital camera, so it fits easily into one's shirt pocket or other small space. This is generally good, but it can also prove to be a problem. Because it is so small, it is easy to lose this camera. A camera this small and thin can fit into many places where other cameras will not fit, so you need to be careful where you leave it. Nikon makes some very good digital cameras and they also make a few average cameras. Nikon Coolpix S220 Digital Camera fits into the latter category. It is a good point and shoot digital camera, but it lacks the sophistication of other cameras and some of its features are inconsistent. Still, it's a decent beginner's camera and its small size and 10 megapixels make it a good choice for those new to the world of digital .

title: HP937 Offers Large LCD Screen and Many Great Pictures
text: The Hewlett- Packard Photosmart R937 Digital Camera is a slightly more advanced digital camera than the average with a few extra features that make some of the simpler digital cameras pale in comparison. I have owned a few different digital cameras in my day and with each purchase, I tend to look for more features in a more user- friendly package. This HP camera combines the features I had on my last Hewlett- Packard camera with a larger viewing screen and more photo effects for more advanced and more convenient photography. Hewlett- Packard Photosmart R937 Digital Camera offers many good reasons to rate it highly but among them, the one that caught my attention first was the huge LCD screen. Small viewing screens are a great annoyance with many digital cameras, but the LCD screen on the Hewlett- Packard Photosmart R937 Digital Camera measures a whopping 3.6 inches. In fact, it encompasses almost the entire back side of the camera and it provided exactly the extra viewing area I wanted. Not only does the large screen make it easy to capture images and clearly see the image you are about to take, it is also perfect for the playback of the video feature. With a screen this large, one can preview a video with ease. There is no need to strain the eyes when the LCD screen on your camera is 3.6 inches. This camera offers many different shooting modes to create just the right picture. Beach, landscape, snow, sunset, etc., are among the many choices and you need to just try each one out to find out which one works best for different situations. I also like the auto- shooting mode. Using this, the Hewlett- Packard Photosmart R937 Digital Camera becomes idiot proof. It will do its best to conform the image electronically, saving the user the time or hassle of seeking out just the right mode. Picture cleanup is also very fast with the Hewlett- Packard Photosmart R937 Digital Camera. The large LCD screen makes it easy to find problems and makes it easy to delete the problems with a touch of the screen. Is everything perfect with the Hewlett- Packard Photosmart R937 Digital Camera? No, there are a few problem areas. One is the lack of available memory. There is enough space on this camera to handle about 20 to 25 pictures. This isn't much at all, and it won't suffice for even the casual picture taker. This is why memory cards are a must with this camera. Another problem is with the zoom function. It doesn't zoom very wide, and it is also one of the few features of the Hewlett- Packard Photosmart R937 Digital Camera that is not activated by using the touch screen. Another small complaint is the time it takes to transfer pictures from the camera to your pc. The 1.1 USB connection isn't very fast, so you have to be patient as you wait for the pictures to flow from one device to the next. Perfect or near- perfect digital cameras may exist, but they will likely cost a week's wages or more and are not practical for the casual photographer. The Hewlett- Packard Photosmart R937 Digital Camera isn't perfect, but it does take plenty of great pictures, offers great editing, has a long battery life, and offers a gigantic LCD viewing area of 3.6 inches, all for a relatively low price. It's a winning digital camera in my book, giving you the minimum features you want plus a little bit more without the excessively high price tag common with the more sophisticated cameras.

title: Stores Your Laptop and Dozens of Related Accessories
text: Case Logic 16-Inch Full Size Security Friendly Laptop Case is a storage and organizational device that is very useful for storage of both laptops and related accessories. I use this case when going on vacation and making other short trips. My laptop almost always accompanies me, and having a safe place to keep my computer is important. This laptop computer bag looks much like other computer bags from the outside. Its black color and Case Logic metal badge with logo make it look like a briefcase when viewed from a distance. This gives the bag a more professional, serious look that makes it a good choice for businessmen and businesswomen. At the same time, the bag looks casual enough that others can use it as well. It could even double as a storage bag for other items and many students could use this case for hauling around a few books, folders, notebooks, and papers. Opening up the Case Logic 16-Inch Full Size Security Friendly Laptop Case reveals an obvious fact: This is no ordinary briefcase/laptop carrying bag. There are separate sections and zippers galore. There are four main sections and these are subdivided into other storage sections with variations in each section that help users find the perfect place to store their notebooks, cell phones, calculators, pens, etc. One of the end sections is designed exclusively for your laptop and includes pillow- like walls to keep your laptop computer safe from damage. The other sections have a combination of pockets without zippers, pockets with zippers, deep pockets, shallow pockets, and even a nylon mesh pocket. With so many pockets and storage areas, one can quickly find the perfect place to store everything from cell phones, to calculators, to CD's, and more. Carrying the Case Logic 16-Inch Full Size Security Friendly Laptop Case is made easy through the two available options: The briefcase- like handles and the optional shoulder strap. I usually use the handles, but if my bag is overloaded, I have found that the shoulder strap is the best way to go. Not only can this strap be used to carry the bag hands- free, it can also be used to strap the bag to a piece of rolling luggage, for even more freedom of movement. The strap is long enough to fit around most any piece of luggage, making a quick run through the airport fast and simple. One other nice feature of the Case Logic 16-Inch Full Size Security Friendly Laptop Case is that it is designed with airport security in mind. This is one of the main appeals of this laptop bag because more often than not, when I am packing my laptop into a bag, it is for taking it on a trip and more than half of my trips involve flights. Case Logic designed this laptop case in compliance with TSA government guidelines so that you don't have to remove the laptop from the case in order to pass it through airport security. This is great for those who don't have time to waste and need to get to their gate as quickly as possible. Case Logic 16-Inch Full Size Security Friendly Laptop Case has many great things to offer, so are there any cons? I can think of only a few. One is the lack of padding in the majority of the compartments. The laptop compartment is protected by padding, but the rest of the case is not. Thus, you have to be careful not to place anything delicate in one of these non- padded sections- particularly the one on the outside. These more delicate items will have to be placed toward the center of the bag instead of at the ends. Another possible con is that this bag is not expandable. Granted, it has enough storage space and is large enough that most anyone can find a place to store what they have. But the lack of expansion means you cannot place a large object inside this storage bag and it also means that some of the larger laptop computers may not fit. Still, in spite of these minor inconveniences, the Case Logic 16-Inch Full Size Security Friendly Laptop Case is a very nice computer case with many great things to offer. It can be used to store your laptop computer and related accessories in many different ways, with a design that is both practical and imaginative.

title: Logitech Eliminates Strain and Improves Precision
text: Logitech Trackball Marble Mouse is one of the better computer accessories I have used and it offers a noticeable improvement compared to traditional computer mice. Its unique shape makes it much more comfortable and a no- sliding- necessary design eliminates the need to drag your mouse across a flat surface to move the computer pointer on your screen. To move the pointer, all you do is move the large, red marble trackball. There is less strain on the fingers and wrist, making for a more comfortable experience. Besides the added comfort, another advantage of the Logitech Trackball Marble Mouse is that it requires less space than a traditional mouse. Because this mouse is stationary and doesn't need to be dragged across a desk or other surface, it can fit into many small spaces. You don't need to make room to drag it, so it can be placed in tight quarters. This is great for those who work in offices with limited desk space. The Logitech Trackball Marble Mouse offers four buttons to use for clicking. The large tabs on each side of the mouse are used for the usual right and left click functions and then there are two smaller tabs right above each of the larger tabs that are used for various functions. These two small tabs can be programmed to perform several things, and many will likely program them to scroll since this Logitech mouse doesn't have a scroll wheel. But the tabs can be programmed for other things, too. Since I don't necessarily need to scroll, my small tabs have been programmed as browser back and forward buttons. This makes life a little easier because I no longer need to move my mouse to the top of my screen and click the forward and backward arrows in the upper left corner. I just click my small left tab to go back and my small right tab to go forward. The Logitech Trackball Marble Mouse is a marked improvement compared to the standard mouse, but I admit that it does take some getting used to. Having used a traditional mouse for most of my computer- using years, I had grown accustomed to sliding my mouse across the desk surface. Thus, when I started to use the Logitech Trackball Marble Mouse, I kept sliding it around on my desk also, even though I knew this mouse didn't need to be dragged. It took some time to break this habit. It also took time to get used to the sensitivity of the trackball. The slightest movement sends your pointer flying and when I first started to use this mouse, I would continually underestimate the precision of the Logitech Trackball Marble Mouse. My movements of the trackball were far too extreme. The pointer would soar across my computer screen, even though I would swear I wasn't moving the trackball very much. It is a very sensitive device that almost seems too loose at first because it moves so freely and with such little effort. Compared to a traditional mouse, the Logitech Trackball Marble Mouse has many great things to offer and it is a mouse I am happy I took the time to try. It is superior to the traditional model in most areas, reducing pain and strain and offering greater accuracy and an easy grip. It does take time to get used to, but it is worth it in the long run and even those who initially resist the change will be happy, in due time, that they made the switch to Logitech.

title: Like Technological Progress? Then You Won't Like This Television
text: Philips Magnavox PR1903C is a simple television set designed for the technologically apathetic. It has very few features and very few of the mechanical and technological updates one would expect in a modern television. This television set offers the usual minimum features a consumer expects to find in any television- like adjustments for color, brightness, etc.- along with a few extras, like a language control that allows the consumer to switch from English to Spanish to French, sleep timer, and close captioning. Most all features have to be accessed from the remote control- the front of the television offers no such options- not even to access the menu. Also, there is only one input jack on the back of the television, placing severe limits on accessory compatibility. If there is one redeeming factor for this television set, it is the quality of the picture. This surprised me at first, because the overall quality of most everything else is below average, leading me to believe that the picture quality would follow suit. But the picture is actually quite good on Philips Magnavox PR1903C. The sharpness is very good and I cannot detect any small lines or other problems with the viewing. In this regard, the television set deserves commendation. I can't really find anything wrong with the picture quality for this type of set. Going back to the negative points, I have noticed that this television set is prone to wear out a little faster than others. One sign of wear that is easily noticeable is the button on the front of the screen, to access the power. This button is a large, round button that is plastic in construction and is enclosed inside a round space. When pressing the button in, it is supposed to snap solidly in place but instead it rattles back and forth a little, making me worry that it is going to pop off. Of course, the way it is situated inside the round space, it cannot come out (as far as I know). But the looseness is obvious and it is a little surprising. With the limited amount of times the power button on the front of the television set is used (it is usually powered on/off with the remote control), I wouldn't expect it to wear out so quickly. Overall, Philips Magnavox PR1903C is an unacceptable television set for the many reasons listed above. I like the sleep timer and the picture quality is certainly very good, but the strikes against this television are numerous. There are too many bad points to make it worthy of a recommendation.

title: Acceptable Television, but Seriously Outdated
text: Sanyo DS25390 is a simple, no- frills television that offers enough features to get by but is lacking in some of the basics that we now take for granted in television sets, making it a questionable choice of sets for many consumers. Starting with the remote control, this television is very limited and quite out of date. Besides the usual keys (the ten numbered buttons, power button, etc.), you get a set- up key, CC key (closed captioning), Enter, and a Previous Channel selector. The various settings for the television can be accessed from the remote using the menu button, and they include the usual options (changing brightness, color, etc.). There isn't much more to it than that and the control itself has an old- fashioned look to it. Picture quality on Sanyo DS25390 is okay, but nothing exceptional. The sharpness is the greatest weakness of this Sanyo television. Depending on your distance from the screen, the images seem a little fuzzy on the edges. At a good distance, this problem is minimized well enough that most people will not notice but it is definitely not as sharp as the picture on most newer models. Picture quality is most important, but one other important consideration when choosing any television is its features and friendliness to accessories. Sanyo DS25390 has limited abilities and limited features. Chief among these is the limits on input. There are only a few input and output jacks and, because of this, there is no way to directly hook up a DVD player or video camera. This fact alone would probably discourage most people from considering this television. You could probably connect a DVD player or other device by going through a VCR first, but how many among is still own a VCR? I realize this television set was considered acceptable during its day, but it is difficult to overlook things like this. One other problem I have with this television is the sound quality. There is only one small speaker, so the sound delivered is in mono. This certainly reduces the sound quality when watching certain movies or music video. The sound is acceptable for most television shows because the need for stereo quality isn't important. But it isn't very good for certain films and other programs that are greatly enhanced with stereo sound. Overall, Sanyo Model DS25390 is a difficult television set to evaluate. It seems adequate in some ways and it was probably considered a good television set when it was first introduced. But compared to modern televisions, I cannot imagine anyone buying this set. The fact that a DVD player cannot be directly hooked up to this television is reason enough to reject it. Add to that the picture quality and its lack of sharpness and you have a television set that is too flawed to recommend. It's inexpensive, yes. But you most certainly get what you pay for.

title: Taking Digital Pictures with Hewlett Packard
text: Hewlett Packard Photosmart M407 is a nice little digital camera that is small enough to fit inside your pants pocket. This camera is one of the best buys around among cameras with greater than 4 megepixels and while there are better cameras on the market, this is a very nice one for the money. My favorite qualities of this camera are its size, its ease of use, and its sharp resolution. Pictures can be taken in VGA (lowest quality) or in 2 MP or 4MP resolution. These higher resolutions are going to eat up more memory but they produce sharp, clear photos. For everyday picture taking, I have found the VGA to be just fine, but for someone who is more experienced as a photographer, the 4 MP setting is needed to produce the sharpest images. The ones you get with this camera at that resolution level are very good, but you need to keep in mind that the memory (without buying a memory card) is capable of storing only about 10 images at this level. Lower the quality to VGA, and you can store about 160 images. Some of the disadvantages of this camera include its video capabilities and the placement of certain buttons and controls. The video is offered with an MPEG format and it produces images at 30 frames per second. Its quality isn't very good and I recommend it only to people who really need/want to take a video and have no other alternative. I don't like the placement of the video and picture shutters on the top of the camera either. The picture button is larger than the video shutter, like it should be since it is used more frequently. But the picture shutter is placed to the left of the video shutter on the top of the camera. The picture shutter is used more and it should be on the right side because, to most people, your instinct is to press the button furthest to the right. I cannot count the number of times I have accidentally pressed the video button by mistake. This camera comes with batteries, two USB cables, a strap, a user manual, and HP image software. This software is nice because it helps new photographers organize pictures and upload them into a pc. The other additions are expected with a digital camera but they help aid in the usability of this electronic device. Overall, HP Photosmart is a good digital camera for the money and it is one of the few that offers more than 4 megapixels at such a low price. It was the first digital camera I ever purchased and I haven't regretted making the buying decision.

title: Useful product
text: I have 3 of these units in the house, each in a different room. The first one is about 3 years old and working just fine. Installation is very simple and value for convenience is great. They are in strategic locations with a light plugged in on the top plug and two usb cords in the bottom. One for the apple orchard and the other for all the other items (Alexa, android or Kindle). Which ever room I find myself in and in need of a quick charging of equipment it is ready and waiting. The one in the family room is the newest and is located by my favorite sitting spot so a quick charge of something I forgot to do earlier can go on while I still use it. This has really worked out for my phone and Kindle. I did not buy the units at the same time but after each time I found a "good" spot for one more. The green light on top is a bit of a night light.

title: Great value and worked perfectly
text: Worked great for a solar charger project i was working on. Comes as a one piece chipset which you seperate by snapping off the individual circuits. Was easy to seperate and item worked great.

title: Great cable cutter
text: I loved that it gave me live tv with directv now. I however wish the voice remote worked better for navigating while using this service. Most times using voice either doesnt work or causes the stick to go to my prime account for searching tv on amazon. Other than that it works awesome. Best product i bought from amazon in many years.

title: Easy plug and play on PS4 and has helped with some issues of a almost full original hard drive
text: great product. I just plugged it into my ps4 and my system detected it, asked me if I wanted to use extended storage and it was set up. Transferred 450gb of data to it in 40 minutes. No sound from it to worry about and makes my system run faster as far as menus go, now that the external hard drive has freed up space for the basic programs to use from the original hard drive. Do not think you will get faster load times I have not really noticed any difference. I had issues with lagging when trying to go to the power off menu or other main menus on the ps4 due to a almost full original 500gb hd this has solved those issues for me. Don't know if others will find the same results but I'm thoroughly pleased.

title: awesome lil record player
text: Just got done playing my starwars records and this player is awesome!!! Less than a minute to set up and the speakers get movie theater loud. If you are expecting hard pounding rattle the windows bass this wont deliver. This unit gives a solid across the board sound quality though. I was really impressed by this unit. Make sure you tighten down antishock screw. Owners manual will tell you where it is... Very important.

title: For now a 5 start rating. Will update my experience in 30 days or so
text: Okay so I will start off that I only paid $49 for this device so a 5 star rating is simply because I'm not heavily invested in this from a cost perspective and for $49 it does the trick and more. I have purchased this inexpensive version to see if I'm a Dashcam kind of person. I purchased the Sandisk 32G card which was super cheap to buy (9.99 I think) and started my dash cam journey. Why 5 stars - It's only day 3 but so far this works as expected. Good resolution and functionality and it is small enough that I installed it behind my rear view mirror and just leave it in my truck. The accessory cord is really long so there is good flexibility to move the camera around my cab as needed and the suction cup mount is the way to go. The packaging was good but the instructions are HORRIBLE. It's 2015 so I have no idea why you can't spend the time build a quality instruction sheet. I have had to figure out how to operate the camera on my own which so far has worked. Today I stuck the camera to the windshield, plugged it in and drove 1 hour to work and another hour back. Worked flawlessly and I realize that I am a Dashcam kind of person now. Simply plug the mini-USB into your computer and view the video files straight from the explorer menu. I'm not sure how long this camera will last. I will update as time passes. I recommend a 32g mem card if you plan on using this a lot and recording in HD. For $49 (plus storage card) this is a great insurance policy. 2 cars pulled out in front of me today. If they had hit me I would have been able to prove them at fault. Also, turn off the motion sensor while driving unless you want the camera restarting often. I found to let it just run is the best solution. Maybe use the motion sensor if you are using the camera as a security feature or something.

title: Port Replicator not a true docking station
text: I'm rating this 4 stars since there is a bit of a gap in what Dell is calling a Docking Station versus what this unit really is. This is essentially a port replicator meaning that you have to have a separate power source to charge the laptop. If it were a true docking station you would be charging your laptop simply by being plugged into it. For this device you plug via USB and having an extra power plug in. Now the good stuff. It works really well and I run triple monitors. Please keep in mind that if your monitors are a bit older and have the pin style plugs you will need adapters to convert to DVI /new style HDMI. Would I buy this again? Yes. Am I happy with my purchase? Overall yes but disappointed about having extra cabling for charging the laptop.

title: Antennas Direct Micron-R ClearStream Micron Indoor UHF DTV Antenna with Reflector Screen
text: This product can work.My review is not to knock this product in a negative way but more to warn folks that if you do not live near the city (or where the TV towers are) then buy at your own risk. I was really looking forward to cancelling my Comcast subscription so I purchased this antenna in lieu of a Comcast payment each month. I purchased the 35 mile radius as I live 25 miles from downtown Seattle. After installation and setup I received only 1 channel. I have to admit the clarity of that one channel was fantastic however I do not speak Spanish so it was a let down. I believe this product works but not if you are on the outskirts of town. I would suggest only buying this if you live 20 miles or less away from city towers. Or if you live up on a hill that faces the city. Just my opinion for us more rural folks. I can tell (from the one channel I did get) that if I lived closer to the city this antenna would simply do the trick. Hope this helps.
