title: Complicated, but it got rid of HDCP for me...
text: 08/13/2020 UPDATE: ------------------------- All right, so a quirk that some of you may encounter is that when you connect the splitter, your TV may turn on Action Smoothing automatically. I have a TCL and that's the term they use. Other TVs may go by a different term. But essentially, it is the "soap opera" effect. It is great for sports, but weird for movies. But when I turned it back to off, the "soap opera" effect was still there. So I thought the splitter overrides the TCL settings, which would make it unusable for me. But on a hunch, I decided to unplug the TCL tv, and when I replugged, the "soap opera" effect was gone. So if you're experiencing this, try unplugging your TV and replugging it. I was able to reproduce this quirk with a different HDMI splitter, so this is not an issue with the HDMI splitter, it is an issue with the TV being stuck on Action Smoothing... In my case, it's a TCL. Original Review ------------------ I needed to disable HDCP for a PC-less capture card. This splitter is more advanced than any splitter I have ever used. I'm used to the splitters that just splits and has no settings. This splitter makes you use your brain, and sometimes I don't want to use my brain. After a lot of tinkering with the various combinations of the switches, I ended up leaving the EDID at COPY1 and the Scaler switches to OFF... which was actually the default settings they ship to you. LOL! Also understand that for every setting you play around with, if you don't get a picture, it might not mean it doesn't work. Along with your settings, you need to try switching your tv inputs back and forth, turning off/on your sources, turning off/on your capture card, etc., to truly see if it works. This will be the most confusing and frustrating part of setting this up. Not to mention, do you have the proper HDMI cables? Manual says use HDMI 2.0 cables. A lot of my cables are 1.3 or 1.4, but it still worked. So maybe if I had some HDMI 2.0 cables, it would have saved me some headache? Ultimately, I stumbled upon the fact that if I leave it at COPY1 and Scalers off, turn off my capture card, then turn it back on, as well as switch tv input, then switch it back. It works! And it's not something you always need to do every time you turn on your tv. It's a one time thing. Once the splitter and your devices are in sync, you're good to go. There is one more step you can take if this doesn't work. There is a pinhole on the splitter labeled "UPDATE." Right on the splitter itself, there are printed notes on what this pinhole is for. Basically after resetting switches, changing inputs, etc., and you still have video or audio issues such as garbled noises, you need to use a tiny pin key, like the ones supplied by your smartphones to remove your sim trays. Poke it inside and feel for a button. Press it until it flashes 3 times. I guess this does some sort of "update" telling the splitter.. "Hey, these are the new settings, get with the program!" It worked for me in fixing garbled audio. I will acknowledge that user experience and expertise level in AV tech plays a role in how much "tinkering" is necessary. The less you know, the more you're going to tinker. Still, I think the manual could be better and more in depth, maybe provide a pin key for the pinhole? Regarding this pinhole, the instructions says to push the "button." There is no button, and I had to look around for my sim key. For most consumers, this won't be "plug and play" as the listing suggest. But it works, and I will go 4 stars for this.

title: You will need a HDMI splitter....
text: THINGS YOU WILL NEED: ---------------------------- -HDMI Splitter that can bypass HDCP (For digital caputuring. What device isn't digital nowadays?) -Flash drive or Hard Drive: Maximum flash drive space is 256gb. Maximum hard drive is 8tb. As a kid, I used to love recording tv or cable to VHS. Then in the late 90's and early 2000's, I was into those Hard Drive recorders with built in dvd-r burners by Pioneer and Philips, remember those? But then Tivo and Cable DVR really took off and made recording to actual dvds a thing of the past. So what we have here with the ClearClick is simply a device that brings the "old way" of archiving to 2020, but instead of VHS and DVR-Rs, it will record as MP4 files into your flash drive. I also think the reason these devices are still relevant is due to the phenomenon of gamers who love to record all their game-play. Anyway, I'm happy to report it does exactly what it advertises brilliantly. However, unless you're only capturing analog signals (VHS transers), you will need a HDMI splitter that can bypass HDCP. In my use case scenario... I have a Caavo Universal Remote/HDMI Switcher. The Caavo has four HDMI inputs. I have my Tivo, a Fire TV, a Android TV box, and the Nintendo Switch hooked to it. Then it has one HDMI output. This output normally goes to the TV. So that's my set-up... Now to hook up this ClearClick, I remove the HDMI that connects to the TV from the Caavo, and instead, I connect it to the Input of the special HDMI Splitter. Then HDMI OUT from this splitter to the input of the ClearClick. Finally, HDMI OUT from the ClearClick to an input on my TV. This way, I can capture from any device I want that's connected to my Caavo. Of course, you can just connect one source at a time too if you don't have a hub like I do. But remember, you need to connect your source to the HDMI splitter first. If you don't, you will just get a black screen that says "unsupported format." One more thing, the HDMI splitter obviously has 2 HDMI outs, one of which is going to the ClearClick. I also use the second HDMI out to connect directly to another input on my TV. The reason is to avoid having to turn on the ClearClick when I'm not recording. The spliiter I use is called the ViewHD Model: VHD-1X2MN3D. You can find this on Amazon. However, I believe it is still YMMV (your mileage may vary.) I bought that years ago and it still works. But if you search in the reviews for that splliter, some do complain it didn't work for them. Sometimes a different batch has different chipsets, I dunno. So it may take trial and error before you get a splitter that works. I also have a 4tb Western Digital passport connected the ClearClick, and it works perfectly. Lastly, inside the box, they give you a free license of Videopad software. This is so you can touch up your recordings, add effects, transitions, or even output to DVD. Before I registered my copy, I wanted to see how much this software cost, so I proceeded to purchase as if I didn't have a code. So currently, it's listed as $99, but it is on sale for $35 until August 15. We get it free!

title: Not just for displaying photos, I have some outside the box ideas...
text: I've always thought photo frames are gimmicky, but FeelCare has changed my mind. The difference in using these versus turning a tablet into a photo frame is that it SIMPLY WORKS as it should. Getting a tablet to be a photo frame is quite involved and requires more maintenance. Also, this item actually looks like a picture frame! When you fire it up, it's actually running Android, a stripped down version that focuses just on being a photo player. The Frameo app allows you to beam photos to it easily. You can designate sleep hours for the frame so that it's not always on 24/7. I have mine asleep from 1 am to 8 am. Techies will turn old tablets into photo frames, but I think the main market here is for older people who are not techies. Great for parents and grandparents, but we'll be using it too and we're not quite grandparents yet. Here are some outside the box ideas... A joke on your friends: -------------------------- Imagine your buddy come over to your house and looking at all the frames on your mantle. Smack dab in the center is a picture of his grandparents, or perhaps, his mom? LOL! He'll be like, "What the... why do you have a picture of my mom?" LOL! To do this joke, you need the frame to have only a few photos that's because it doesn't know how to display just 1 photo all day. It has to be in Slideshow mode 24/7. But you can select photos to hide. So if you have 5 photos, you can easily hide 4 of it, then it will only show 1 photo all day. If you have 200 photos, you would have to select 199 to hide. The joke is probably not worth that hassle. LOL! To pull it off, you also need to lower the brightness so that it matches the brightness of the regular surrounding pictures. And of course, hide the wires as best you can. Card Magic Trick: ------------------- I do card magic, and immediately I thought of a use for this frame. Have your spectator choose a card, then read his mind, then point him to the photo frame and say, "is that your card?" If you do Magic, you'll figure out plenty of ways to pull off this trick. This frame is pretty neat! 5 Stars!

title: Easy peasy back up!
text: I read some of the reviews and concerns. Many are saying you need the original power adapter. My testing says that is NOT true. I plugged this cube into two separate charging hubs, not apple brand, and both scenarios worked. You need a micro SD card (not included). Some of the questions in the Q&A shows that shoppers don't realize this. There is no built in hard drive in this cube, you provide the storage. Turning off auto-sleep/auto-lock may get you through thousands of pictures in one shot. This is what I mean... I'm no stranger to trying out different back-up programs. The current program we use is from Plex. When the iphone is backing up to my plex server, the iphone doesn't know that plex is working, so it goes to sleep after about 50 pictures. When it goes to sleep, plex stops backing up. So I always turn off auto-sleep prior to backing up. With the Qubii, the iphone KNEW that it was working, so it "almost" never went to sleep. I said almost because after 4000 files, for some reason, the phone went to sleep. Still, this is much, much, better than the plex app. When I started Qubii again, it picked up where it left off and backed the remaining 1000+ files. But I did the test one more time to make sure! I cleared the micro sd card, and I reset the Qubii count. This time I turned off auto-sleep/auto-sleep on the iphone, and it backed-up the entire camera roll of over 5000 photos and videos in one shot! More trials need to be done to conclusively say this thing can't get through 5000 files without the auto-sleep disabled. After backing up everything, you should remove your SD card from the Qubii and transfer them to a larger permanent hard drive where you store your collection. The next time you charge your phone, the Qubii will remember the photos it already backed-up even if those photos are no longer on the SD card. So you can always clear your SD card. For whatever reason, if you need the Qubii to back-up the same photos again, like I did when I was testing things out, all you have to do is RESET the Qubii count, which you can do in the Back Up Settings in the app. Below are the two pictures showing you the scenarios in which I tested this Qubii. Both scenarios used third party charging hubs, but I believe I had the original apple cable. As with all products dependent on apps.. one Apple update can ruin everything. LOL! So these types of app products depend on the company to stick around, so that if Apple breaks anything, they can fix it with a new firmware update. Qubii was on Kickstarter, but only time will tell. As is, this is an amazing product.

title: Subtle Wavy Diagonal Lines....
text: You know I see a lot of positive reviews, and if you're happy that's all that matters. But I'm wondering if all the positive is because people are not comparing one adapter to another, so they don't know any better. This adapter is a generic design, most likely a white label product, meaning many people are selling the same thing, and they are just slapping their own logo on it. I bought this version and the MayFlash version, and after comparing them, I returned this generic version. I got wavy diagonal lines with this generic version. The picture is still okay, but I could see the lines. With the MayFlash, it was gone. The picture was much smoother. I don't know if using a projector makes a difference, but that is what I'm using, an ultra short throw projector with a 120" screen. With such a big image, maybe I'm seeing the diagonal lines much easier. So I'm not sure if this is the case for people using smaller LCD tvs. In any case, all else being equal, if the mayflash could eliminate the lines for me on a 120" image, it would surely do a spectacular job for smaller screens. If you see subtle wavy diagonal lines, then give the mayflash a try. If you don't see any lines with this version, then stick with it, no need to tinker. This was just my experience.

title: Terrific case for my Pixel Slate!
text: Right off the bat, you need to understand I did not purchase this case for a Surface Pro, I purchased it for the Pixel Slate. It is very difficult to find any accessories for the Slate, but luckily the Slate and the Surface Pro are very similar in size. The Slate is about 291mm x 202mm x 7mm The Surface Pro 292mm x 201mm x 8.5mm Since the Pro is a little thicker, I figure I can fit the Google Keyboard as well as the Slate inside this case, and sure enough, I was right! I don't really care for the multipoint angles of the Google keyboard because I'm sharing the tablet with my 6 yr old and that design is not kid-friendly. This case makes it kid friendly as well as protect everything from scratches. It also makes it sturdier because if you want, you can even hold the entire thing with one hand, something you cannot do if the Slate and Google board is not inside this case. I first bought a similar case by Infiland for $24. When I realized this Finite version is basically the same case for less money, I bought it to see which charcoal color I like better. The Fintie is not only $8 cheaper, but has the better darker charcoal. There are slight differrences in stitching pattern too but I'm willing to bet both cases are made from the same factory. If you need this for a Pixel Slate like me, then both cases will work! I've posted some pictures so you can see the color difference as well as how the Pixel looks inside of it.

title: One word.... UNCOMFORTABLE.
text: At $160, I said Nah. At $120, I said let me check this out, and my instincts were right, this is a no-go. Brydge seems to be a legit aspiring company, but I hope they go back to the drawing board and add upper cases to their keyboard design. So that you can put your tablet in a case, then the case connects to the keyboard, a perfect example of this design is an iPad keyboard made by Yoozon, I just reviewed it, it is awesome. There is absolutely no fear of damaging the screen with that type of design. But as for this Brydge keyboard, one word sums up my experience.. uncomfortable. So there are 3 issues with this design: 1. There is no case, your tablet is exposed. This is not a deal-breaker, I knew it going in. But understand nobody makes any cases for pixel slate. Even Brydge makes a bunch of cases for various ipads complete with slots cut-out so that they can be slide right into their hinge keyboards. But there are no such products for the Slate, so you'll expose it to scatches. 2. Light bleeding in the corner caused by the hinges. I knew this going in as well, but I was thinking maybe it's paranoia. At $120, I wanted to check it out. And honestly, playing with it did not ease my concerns. You don't see any light bleeding at all, but you do see it when you close it like a laptop and the hinge is applying its pressure. I tried to reproduce this light bleed by applying pressure with my thumb, and I could not get it to bleed. So this tells me the hinge is applying a tremendous amount of pressure. Right now, the bleeding goes away the moment it's opened, but by opening and closing constantly and daily, I fear one day the bleeding will stay lit because I've seen this issue on normal laptops. 3. The hinge is a very thin sharp metal. The padding is what prevents it from scratching your tablet. But the padding for one hinge was no longer sticking flush with the metal. It would get caught at times when I'm sliding in the tablet. Good thing I was careful because if you carelessly trust the product, it can scratch your tablet if the rubber gets caught and pulled. Hard to articulate what I'm saying, so I've attached a photo to show you the separation of the rubber from the thin metal hinge. After a couple of uses, it was a chore for me to carefully slide the tablet in because that rubber kept getting caught. A little disappointed that just one day into this testing, I already have to resort to glue? Like I said... uncomfortable. Brydge, please continue to focus on rigid hinge keyboards. You're on the right path. This is what we want. We want rigidness and lappability, but please design a detachable case so that the case takes the brunt of the hinge pressure, as well as protect the tablet from scratches exactly like the Yoozon design I mentioned above.

title: So much more than Harmony
text: I was using the Harmony companion for the longest time, and before that, the Harmony 900. This Caavo is by far the best universal remote because it's so much more than that. Harmony is just a remote, it does not give you one unified user interface. If you've played around with a Smart TV's user interface, then you'll get the idea what this Caavo is all about. Except with Smart TV's, you still have to reach for your other devices' remotes, and if any device has voice search, it's only good for that specific device. The Caavo controls and searches all your devices! If I have a movie that's in my Tivo, that's in my plex, that is also available on Netflix.. all the choices are presented to me, so I can launch it from whichever device I choose. I have PLEX as my search priority, and it works beautifully. I was also a little nervous when hooking everything up because my TV is a Samsung from 2009, my Audio system is Sony from 2010. The Caavo has ZERO issues controlling everything. My set-up. Input 1: Tivo Input 2. Fire TV Input 3: Chromecast Input 4: Currently Nothing Optical OUT to my SONY AV system My TIVO is set as the default. So when I push the power button on the remote. The Sony AV system comes on, tv comes on, and Tivo is what I'm watching! I was pleasantly surprised that it has all my Tivo controls because each button does double duty by short or long press. Let's say I want to watch a movie, I use the voice search to say BACK TO THE FUTURE, and since Plex is my priority, CAAVO gives me a list of choices with Plex highlighted. If it's in my tivo, netflix, prime, etc. it will give me all the options, but Plex will be highlighted since I set it as my priority. If I hit play, the Caavo switches input to my fire tv, launches Plex and auto-starts Back to the Future. And it happens fairly quickly. It's buttery smooth. If your preferred device to play Plex is on something else, say a Roku, you can set Roku as the default to launch Plex. If I fling something from my phone to the Chromecast, Caavo switches to my Chromecast input automatically. The voice search is perfect for youtube too because If you search something that doesn't sound like a movie, for example, How to Shop For a Miter Saw, the search results will show that there is no such movie, but included in the search results are youtube WEB searches, so you can easily play a youtube video on how to shop for a miter saw. LOL! Youtube is something I mainly do on my phone or pc because of the typing involved. But because of Caavo's voice search, we're watching it more on the big screen. BTW, the voice recognition is terrific. It's pretty much on par with anything else out there. I've seen videos where some guy is complaining that he says Open Plex and it keeps giving him search results for DUPLEX. I don't know if Caavo has improved since his reviews, or if it just didn't like his voice, but I've never had an issue with Caavo not understanding what I said. Alexa, Google Assistant, etc. can also be integrated, but I don't see them as an efficient way to use Caavo, unless you lost the Caavo remote, then you can ask Alexa to turn on your tv I guess. There is a slight learning curve, but it will be time well spent. And it will be easy to teach to your household members because it simply works. Lets face it, non-techies in the home will never touch your Harmony, right? I've used Harmony for 10 yrs, and nobody in my family touches it. They know how to use this Caavo!! This is a game changer! July 17, 2019 UPDATE: -------------------------- If you have Plex as your search default, I have a tip for you. The voice search will not understand funky spelling. For example the documentary "Comix: Beyond the Pages." The voice search will spell Comix correctly as COMICS, and so you will get zero results. But if you simply say "Beyond the Pages," the search engine will be able to find "Comix: Beyond the Pages" for you. Another quirk I ran into was "Mr. and Mrs. Smith." Even though the search engine spelled it exactly as my Plex has it, for some reason it didn't find this title. But if I just say, "Smith," it then pulls up the movie for me. So basically when you hit a snag, just use fewer words instead of saying the whole title. That's it! I really love this feature of the Caavo.

At first I couldn't figure out how to hook up the SOLEMATE to the computer, iPad or the iPod then the hubby pointed out that there's a cord underneath it that attaches to them so I'm good to go. The Bluetooth range is great as well. 33 feet I believe I read but I know my husband was able to walk the entire length of the milking parlor without having any disruption... oh and there's a convenient bag to put the SOLEMATE in so it's safe from sand and water (though I wouldn't recommend getting it wet or sandy on purpose). We had it in the bag and coveredd with paper towels. My only complaint is that the instruction manuals really aren't very thick.. just basic information - and while I don't mind learning by doing it would be much simpler and less frustrating if there was someplace I could find answers - besides reading through other reviews. title: 4.5 blue ribbon Romance Junkies review
text: At the tender age of fourteen, Davie Adams's life is ripped apart. His mother's loose ways leads to a series of events that leave him homeless after his she dies in his arms. Grief-stricken, Davie makes the decision to leave Blackburn and go in search of his father. Davie could have returned to his grandfather's house but he can't imagine remaining in Blackburn and having to endure the pitying looks and talk about his mother. After his mother's collapse, Davie runs for help and finds Tom Makepeace. They get his mother situated in the back of his wagon and are getting ready to head to the infirmary but she passes away moments later. Immediately afterward Davie jumps from the wagon and runs into the woods. Everyone assumes he'll return. Tom even yells into the woods for Davie to come to his home when he's ready that he's welcome there. Davie has other plans though. He does go to the Makepeace's home but it's only to spend the night in their barn. He hadn't expected anyone to see him but Judy, Tom's daughter and Davie's longtime friend spots him from her window. She goes out to see him and reassures him that his mother's body is taken care of and his grandfather will be just fine. Judy realizes that Davie has to do what he feels is right for him but she also knows that her feelings for him have gone beyond friendship. Davie leaves the following morning with nothing more than the desire to leave his memories behind him. Life on his own isn't everything he thought it would be and his search for his father proves fruitless. For years Davie travels and holds many different jobs but through it all Judy and his life in Blackburn remain firmly at the forefront of his mind. THE LONER is sure to pull at readers' heartstring. Spanning over an eight year time period, you get a lot of insight into the characters' personalities and backgrounds. I love that Josephine Cox doesn't focus solely on Davie and Judy's story, there are many other characters who possess stories of their own which add a feeling of realism to this storyline. Davie's journey of self discovery is the main theme and it's a story you won't want to miss. Josephine Cox is a gifted storyteller who knows how to keep readers engrossed page after page so that the doldrums of winter just disappear. Chrissy Dionne (courtesy of Romance Junkies)

You can download Google docs and your kids can use this device to complete their schoolwork. The battery life is good and the tablet is easy to operate. This is a great device that will allow your kids to become more familiar with computers in a way that's supervised and safe.

title: Quality Card and Convenient Adapter
text: This is a very nice MicroSD card and adapter kit. The card is 64GB which provides you plenty of memory. This card is suitable for phones, cameras, or anything else that needs memory. The USB and SD card adapter make it easy to upload files to your computer. You can just pop the MicroSD card into the adapter, plug the adapter into your computer, and transfer files. This is an excellent product that makes it very convenient to manage your data.

title: Fun Camera That's Easy to Use
text: This camera is highly intuitive to operate and comes with a ton of accessories. It has a waterproof case that can be opened by sliding over a tab on the top. The power button is on the front, the shutter button is on the top, and there are zoom buttons on the side. These buttons also have operating functions when you are in the menu mode. There's also a display screen. It includes a charging cable and various mounting accessories. This camera is a great way to get a ton of fantastic pictures without even thinking about it. You can just clip it onto your clothing, set it to take pictures, and go about your day. The camera is durable, lightweight, protected from the elements, and easy to use. The camera comes in a very nice box and would make a thoughtful gift for the photographer in your life. The picture quality is also very good. This action camera is a wonderful accessory for anyone who enjoys photography.

title: Comfortable Headphones with Good Sound
text: These are a nice set of affordably priced headphones. The headphones are comfortable and the sound reproduction is very good. I got these for my daughter who prefers them to ear buds. The headband adjusts in two places which ensures you'll get a proper fit. The earcups swivel and feature a soft, leather pad. Finally, the headphones come with a long cord that is very convenient. The headphones come in an attractive box that make them a good gift idea. This is a nice product.

title: Nice Calculator
text: This calculator features large buttons, a stylus, and a writing area that can be cleared with the press of a button. The writing area is a wonderful feature that allows you to jot down quick notes as you make calculations. This would be a great calculator for any type of exam. Note that there is a lock button on the bottom of the calculator that prevents the writing area from clearing. This is useful if you want to maintain some notes and don't want to accidentally erase them as you perform your calculations. When you're done, you can unlock the screen by sliding the button and erase like normal. The calculator is a nice size. It folds shut and features a durable exterior that protects the buttons and the writing screen. This is a great choice for the upcoming school year.

title: Great For Car Trips
text: This is a nice portable DVD player that is very easy to use. All you have to do is put in the DVD and it starts playing automatically. There are convenient controls that will allow children to adjust volume without any difficulty. The screen is very large making this portable player a good travel option. It has good battery life and it can play while it's recharging. The player includes several cables including a car charger. The player is lightweight and folds down to the size of a standard laptop. Both the sound and the picture are of good quality. This is a nice item that will help keep your children entertained both at home and during car trips or airplane flights.

title: Great For Television or Computer
text: I got this product because I like to ride my stationary bicycle while I watch a film on my computer. In the past, I used a set of headphones for audio. However, the cable was cumbersome and got in the way. With this product I can listen to my computer without having annoying wires interfering with my enjoyment of the film. The headphones are high quality and feature great sound reproduction. The purchase price includes headphones, a transmitter, a power cable, a micro USB charging cable, an RCA converter cable, a digital optical cable, and a 3.5mm audio cable. The USB cable can be used to charge the headphones, or you can use the transmitter which features a headphone cradle. I elected to connect this to my computer with the 3.5mm audio cable and it works great. The headphones have a volume key which is easy to operate while you're wearing them. This is a high quality item that is comfortable to wear and provides good sound. The packaging is also very attractive which makes this a thoughtful gift idea.

title: Easy to Use, Portable Amp
text: This is a nice little amp about the size of a car radio. It comes with a small remote control and an instruction booklet. It's very easy to hook up to a set of speakers and the controls are highly intuitive. It took a moment for the amp to scan the FM channels and then I was able to easily find all my local stations. I was also able to hook it up to my cellphone via Bluetooth without any problems. The device is listed as "Moukey MAMP3" on your phone's available Bluetooth connections. The item also features red and white audio connectors, but I got this to use mainly for Bluetooth. The unit comes well protected in packing foam to ensure it will arrive to you in good working order. I like the size and the durable construction of this amp. This is a perfect piece of audio equipment for a small apartment, dorm room, or for under a television. This is a nice product and would make a thoughtful gift.

title: Great Accessory
text: I like to listen to audiobooks as I go on long bike rides and this is the best speaker I've found for that purpose so far. I've used other speakers that sit in the water bottle cages, but the sound is muffled by my frame bag. Also, I prefer to ride with two bottles. This speaker rests on the handlebars, so it's closer to your ears and provides a superior listening experience. The mount screws securely in place and there are plenty of spacers provided to ensure this will fit on a wide variety of bar diameters. The speaker screws into the mount in the same fashion that a camera can be affixed to a tripod. It's convenient to have both a light and a power bank mounted on your bicycle, and this speaker has a great battery life. It is highly water resistant and can handle less than ideal conditions. This is a terrific bicycle accessory.

title: Great For Virtual Learning
text: I'm doing virtual learning with my children this school year and this laptop table helps convert any room into a classroom. The legs fold out on the bottom and provide you a stable writing space whether you're sitting on the floor or on a chair. This item even works great for road trips and it allows your kids to stay occupied with creative activities rather than be entertained by videos. It's a lightweight table that my 6 year old can carry without any difficulty, but it's sturdy enough to support a computer. There is a storage tray that pulls out from the side where you can keep writing instruments. When you fold up the legs, it takes up minimal storage space. This is a very useful item to have around the house.

title: High Quality Item
text: This is a durably constructed power strip that comes in a bright yellow color that's easy to spot. This is an ideal item for use in your garage because you're likely to notice it from a distance and not accidentally run it over with a vehicle. The power strip has six outlets on the front and there are four mounting holes on the back so you could easily hang this from a work bench or wall. The power cable has a thick casing that won't crack or break with regular use. This is a terrific item for a workshop or anywhere around the house.

title: Compact, High-Quality Speakers
text: These speakers are compact, look great, and provide a high-quality sound that can fill up a room. The cabinet features an attractive looking wood grain that will perfectly complement your existing decor. The convenient wall mount bracket on the back makes it easy to hang these speakers for optimal sound coverage. The speakers come with two speaker cables, or you can use your existing speaker cables. All you have to do is hook them up and enjoy. The sound quality is very high and these speakers are a great option for a home entertainment system. Whether you want to listen to your favorite recording artist, or watch the latest Hollywood release, these speakers will greatly enhance your audio experience.

title: Never Run Out of Memory
text: I sometimes work as a tour guide for popular destinations in South America. On those occasions, I'll usually buy a few extra SD cards to give to clients in case they fill up their memory. There is nothing worse than seeing people get halfway through the trip of a lifetime only to have to start deleting photos because they don't have enough space left over to take pictures of the primary attraction. This is a really good card that will allow you enough memory to take all the pictures you want. At 50 MB/s, this is a very fast card that is more than adequate for most situations. If you haven't upgraded your SD card lately, this product is an excellent choice.

title: Versatile, Elegant Backpack
text: This is a terrific backpack that is equally suitable to be used as a school bag as it is to be used as a professional briefcase. The shoulder straps fold into a compartment on the back of the bag, and there are handles both on the top and on the side. The bag has a zipper around the body that allows it to expand to a comfortably sized overnight bag. The inner compartment has a laptop sleeve as well as elastic straps to secure clothing. The versatility of this bag makes it a perfect gift. It is suitable as an everyday bag and is also a perfect travel size. It is very durably constructed with an elegant appearance. This is a high quality product that will provide you with years of service.

title: Very Simple Out of the Box
text: This product couldn't be any easier to use. You pull it out of the box, pull the stylus from its slot, and start drawing. There is a little switch on the back that you have to flip to unlock the screen, but other than that there's nothing to it. The lines are drawn in a pleasing green color on a black background that is very easy to see. When you're done, you push the button at the bottom to completely erase the face of the tablet. I find that my kids are always fascinated by things like smart phones or tablets, but they are prone to dropping them or wrecking them in other ways. This product is a great, inexpensive alternative to an expensive electronic device that will keep kids busy for hours. My eldest daughter is getting into making stop motion videos, and I thought this tablet would be a nice tool for animation. Rather than using a bunch of paper for a flip book, she can draw on the tablet, take a picture, and then clear the tablet before drawing the next image. Note that you aren't supposed to get the tablet wet just like any other electronic device. The device is very thin and easy to handle. It operates on a watch battery. I think this is a great product for taking notes, saving paper, and for encouraging your child's creativity.

title: Great Party Camera
text: This camera is marketed for kids, but it's a fun, simple product that is also great for parties. The images print out in black and white, which is nice because it allows you to get a ton of prints off a single roll of paper. The paper is thin like a receipt you'd get at a restaurant or retail store. It comes with three rolls, and you can take a lot of pictures with what's included with the camera. Be careful when you tear off the pictures because if not enough paper is extending out of the slot, the printing can jam. It's very easy to fix however. The camera also includes a micro USB card which records all of your images. Be sure to charge the camera when you pull it out of the box because it doesn't come with enough energy to print right away. It takes a little while to get used to the controls, but it's pretty easy once you get the hang of it. This is a really fun product for both kids and adults.

title: Great External DVD Drive
text: This is an excellent external DVD drive which allows you to watch movies or burn CDs/DVDs. I do a lot of work with photography and I found the SD and TF slots to be very useful. I have an adapter, but now that this external drive is always plugged in I can just use the slot on that. The drive is very small and has an attractive black casing. The connection/power cable folds into the body of the drive for convenient portability. I do wish that the cable was longer because I use this with my desktop and I'd like to have the drive on my desk rather than perched on my computer. However, for portability, I understand why the cable is short. You do not have to install any software to run the drive, but you will need burning software and software to watch DVDs. These programs are likely already installed on your computer, and there are free versions available if you need them. If you have a computer that does not have a DVD drive, this product is an excellent choice.

title: Nice Sport Watch
text: This sport watch is a pleasing shape and size and is easy to operate. It has two buttons on the side and a touch screen for navigation. The watch face goes black after a few seconds to help conserve battery life. The band is comfortable and has a little stretch to help ensure a snug fit. The watch has a variety of good features that allow you to monitor your fitness data as you follow an exercise program. It's very intuitive to use this watch and it provides you with good information that helps make your physical activities more fun. It also comes with a charging cradle. This watch is a good option if you want an accessory that will help you improve your overall health.

title: Easy to Set Up and Works Great
text: I got this little webcam for video conferencing. It is very easy to set up. All you have to do is plug the USB cable into your computer. I used the camera with Skype and it was up and running with an image almost instantly. The camera has a nice little clip that allows you to mount it on a monitor. It's even got a camera mount on the bottom so you can affix it to a tripod. Good product.

title: Elegant Looking Smart Watch
text: This is a very nice sport watch that you can use to monitor your workouts. You have to attach the wrist bands to the watch face, but it comes with a small tool to make the job easier. The clasp on the wrist band can also be adjusted for sizing with the same tool. The watch connects easily to your phone after you download the free "Link to Health" app. I found the app on the google play store and had no difficulty installing it on my Samsung Galaxy s7. The app automatically sets the watch time. The watch has no buttons and you operate it through the touch screen. You can select between several attractive themes. This watch and band looks very nice and is equally appropriate out on the trail or at a formal gathering. It's easy to track your workout data, and this is a useful device to help you achieve your fitness goals.

title: Durable and Attractive Backpack
text: This backpack has comfortable padded straps that effectively distribute your load weight. In the main compartment there is a padded computer sleeve, two side pouches, and two small pockets on the front. A thick string runs through the top of the bag with a barrel style cord lock. The front straps have buckles for decoration, but it is held closed with magnetic clasps. The pattern and color of the fabric are true to what appears in the item description. This is a stylish and practical bag that is perfect for travel or school.

title: Comfortable and Durable Backpack
text: I am very impressed with this backpack. It has ample padding on the back and comfortable straps which distribute the weight well even when it's fully loaded. This is a perfect backpack for students who have a long walk to class, or for travelers who want a good day pack. The straps on the front have magnetic clasps so this bag is very easy to open and close. The central compartment has a cinch string to ensure your contents are well secured. The main compartment is amply sized and has a padded laptop sleeve. There are also four small inner pockets that offer a variety of uses. The small front pocket closes with a zipper, and there is a pocket on either side of the bag that is ideal for a water bottle or for stuffing a lightweight shirt or windbreaker. The colors are vibrant and the overall design of this backpack is very attractive. This is a practical and durable item that will provide years of use.

title: Great Educational Microscope
text: This is well made, durable microscope that offers a variety of great features. The adjustment knob is large and easy to operate. The knob offers both coarse and fine adjustments so it's easy to get your subject into focus. The kit comes with 10X and 25X eyepieces. These slide easily into the top of the microscope. The microscope features a revolving nose piece so you can orient yourself so it's easier to place objects on the stage. The set also includes a camera eyepiece and software on a mini CD. The camera eyepiece connects to a USB cable so you can view your subject on a computer screen. This is a wonderful feature for classrooms. The power button on the back toggles between a lower light source and an upper light source. The upper light source is great for examining opaque items like pine leaves or tree bark. There is also a dimming adjustment wheel on the bottom so you can adjust light brightness. All of the moving components rotate easily and snap into position. This is a highly intuitive with a lot of great features which makes it great for scientists of all ages. This item is perfect for everything from classrooms to labs.

title: Powerful and Portable Chromebook
text: This is a very nice Chromebook with a lot of good features. You sign in with your gmail account and you can access drive, search the internet, and watch videos. The computer can be used with multiple users. This is a perfect device for travel because the Chromebook is so compact that it can fit easily into a backpack or handbag. This would also be the perfect choice for taking notes at school. My children are seven and nine and they use Chromebooks like this for their classes. It's intuitive enough for small children, but powerful enough for adults. On one side of the computer there is an audio jack, USB port, HDMI port, and a USB-C port for charging. There are also two lights to indicate battery and power status. The other side has a MicroSD slot and another USB port. The keyboard is full-sized and easy to operate. The keys depress and it's easy to type quickly and accurately. There is also a touch pad that works like a mouse. The computer is a pleasing weight and has an attractive overall design. The hinges on the back are durable and provide a smooth opening action. This is a good choice as a first computer for children, or as a secondary device for professionals on the go.

title: Great Summer Item
text: This is a durable cooler that has a Bluetooth speaker in the lid. To turn the speaker on, you open up a rubber flap. Beneath the flap is an on/off switch and a USB charging port. The cooler is well constructed with a carrying handle and a drink dispensing valve at the bottom. It is easy to connect your speaker to your cell phone or other digital device. The speaker produces high quality sound. This is a fun item for social gatherings or trips to the beach.

title: Great Printer
text: This printer makes delightful 4" by 6" photos from your cell phone camera images. The printer is small at only 11" long by 6.5" wide. It plugs into a standard outlet and you operate it with the HP Sprocket app which is free to download. If you have problems downloading the app, you might have to go into your phone's settings and choose the option to clean up your memory. The instructions are easy to follow and are included in the app. You load up the paper in the front tray and the ink cartridge in the side panel. Note that you have to orient this printer so that it has enough clearance to allow the paper to extend from the back. The image goes through the printer several times to add the different color layers, so the printing process takes a few seconds. If you put the back side of your printer up against a wall, it could interrupt the process. The resulting image is the same quality as a print shop 4" X 6" photo. The photo is ejected from the printer with a white space on the top and bottom of the image. There are serrated lines on the photo paper so you can easily tear the excess away. The printer only comes with a starter kit of paper, but paper and ink refills are readily available and inexpensive. This is a great item to create a more permanent copy of treasured digital images. If you are looking for a nice gift for a grandparent, this would be a perfect choice.

title: Nice Portable DVD Player
text: This is a great little DVD player. It comes with a remote control, HDMI cable, a power cable, and an RCA cable. I use mine with a projector for outdoor movie night when I don't to risk exposing my laptop to the elements. The remote control is easy to operate and this DVD player produces a fine image. It works great!

title: Nice Little Projector With Built-In Speaker
text: This is a nice little item for giving presentations or to use for home entertainment. The image is bright enough to use in a lighted room for things like power point presentations, but for watching a movie it is better to turn out the lights. The projector comes with a power cable, an RCA connector, an HDMI cable and a remote control. The projector hooks up easily and has a convenient dial on the side for bringing the picture into focus. As an inexpensive projector, this item is a nice value. I give a lot of presentations, and although most of the venues where I speak have their own projectors, it's nice to bring this one along as a back-up. It fits easily in a laptop bag, and it gets the job done. The controls are easy to understand and the item works great. The built-in speaker means that you can bring this along on camping trips for outdoor movie night. It's a fun and functional projector.

title: Attractive and Durable Bag
text: This is a nice over the shoulder bag for students, professionals, and travelers. It is made out of a durable canvas that is resistant to liquids and tears. It has leather straps and buckles down the front, but those are just decorative. The flap stays closed by magnets that make it easy and convenient to open the bag. There is a padded computer sleeve inside, and another internal compartment. There is also a zipper compartment on the back which is useful for things like pens, change, or important documents. The shoulder strap is easily adjustable and has a comfortable pad in the center. The bag is a good size, and will accommodate most laptops. This is is a great choice for a nice-looking, all-purpose bag.

title: Superior Sound
text: If you decide to invest in a high quality television, it only makes sense that you would purchase a nice sound bar to amplify the audio for a true movie theater experience. This set consists of a simple sound bar and a woofer that greatly improves your audio quality. The set also includes various cables so you can hook up to a variety of different audio output sources. Note that if you have an older television, it might not be compatible with this unit even if you have an optical audio output on your television. You need a television that can produce a digital audio output in PCM format. Older televisions don't have an option to change the digital audio output, and the result will be a buzzing sound from the speaker. This is not a sign of a defective unit, it only means the speaker is receiving a non-compatible signal. Try the auxiliary inputs instead. If your television is less than about 7 years old, you shouldn't have any issues. This speaker creates sound that fills the room and helps provide a better cinematic experience. The sound bar is small and inconspicuous, and the woofer can be tucked away on a shelf or in a corner. You can control the volume with a small remote control that is also included, and there are additional controls on the sound bar itself. This is a perfect sound system for most living spaces.

title: Superior Design and Sound
text: These DALI IO-6 headphones offer a superior listening experience. The sound quality is absolutely fantastic and allows you to pick up nuances in your music that you've never been able to hear before. The ear cups are large enough to fit completely over your ear and offer a nice seal. I like that there is space between the padding and the speaker which helps enhance air movement. I thought these headphones offered great replication for high, middle, and bass sounds. The speakers charge with a USB-C cable that is included, and offer an astonishing 30 hours of battery life. The speakers also come with an audio cable, and they even have an attachment that allows you to plug the audio cable into the dual jack you find on airplanes. There is also a high quality carrying case that zips closed. I liked that there is an actual switch on the side of the headphones to turn them off and on. I much prefer a physical switch to a button you have to press until a light shows the headphones have been activated. You can power these down after use without having to take them off and look at what you're doing. The instant power off switch also helps to preserve battery life because other headphone models stay on when connected to Bluetooth even when you aren't listening. The right hand speaker has extremely sensitive push controls. You can push the center piece to stop, reverse, or advance your music, and you can push the top or bottom of the rim to adjust volume. I prefer the push controls to touch sensitive controls because they are more responsive. I found the push controls to be highly intuitive and easy to operate. These headphones are comfortable to wear and offer superior sound quality. They connect instantly via Bluetooth, and have a stylish design. Even the packaging is very attractive and would make these headphones a much appreciated gift. If you're looking a superior set of headphones, these are a great choice.

title: Great Concept, Solid Execution
text: I like to listen to audio books as I go on bike rides, so I've been looking for a product like this. When I run I use over the ear headphones, but I can't fit those on over or under my cycling helmet. These sunglasses are a great solution. There are speakers underneath the arms that broadcast music almost directly into your ears. The effect is an open ear speaker system that allows you to hear your music, but also lets you stay mindful of ambient noises. The sunglasses have enough of a tint to be comfortable, but not so much that they are impractical in low light. The arms rest easily on your ears and the nose piece is a solid bit of plastic that does not pinch the bridge of your nose. The glasses are very light even with the battery and speaker system. The sunglasses connect to your cell phone via Bluetooth without any issues. There is a large power button on the right arm that is easy to locate by touch. I preferred these for comfort and for sound quality to ear buds. The sound quality is about what you'd expect for tiny speakers mounted to the arms of sunglasses. It's not concert hall quality, but it gets the job done, and it's better than a lot of other speakers on the market. These sunglasses are great for athletes who like to listen to music while they're out exercising. Also included is a case, a bag, a lens cloth, and a charging cable.

title: Rugged, Practical Backpack
text: This is a lightweight, rugged backpack that is ideal for everything from travel to college classes. Also included is a small zip-up pouch that is big enough to hold a wallet, toiletry items, or anything else you'd like to separate from the main compartment. The top compartment has two buckle straps. You can use the buckle straps to open and close the backpack, but they also attach via a magnetized clasp. The spacious interior has a computer sleeve, a zip pouch, and two shallow pockets. There are zip pockets on both sides on the bag's exterior that could be used for water bottles or coffee mugs. There is also a large zip compartment on the front. The straps have minimal padding, but they are wide and comfortable. There is also a chest clasp on the front and a thick hook strap at the top. The green color is attractive and combines well with the leather straps. This is a very attractive, highly functional backpack.

title: Beautiful, Rugged Backpack
text: This is the perfect backpack if you are thinking about putting your life on hold and embarking on an adventurous trip across Europe, South America, or anywhere the spirit of travel might call you. The bag is made from a tough leather with ample storage space. There is a laptop sleeve in the inner compartment, and a hidden zipper on the back for critical documents. All the pockets feature decorative straps and buckles, but they open and close with a magnet clasp. The shoulder straps have minimal padding, but this pack is small enough that it's not extremely heavy when full. It's a nice looking pack that will protect your gear and allow you to travel in comfort and style. This would be a great choice as a gift for a high school student or college freshman.

title: Good Camera With Lots of Accessories
text: I am very impressed with this camera. It is a lightweight, easy to use unit that comes with a ton of great accessories. The camera has a fold out screen that you can use for viewing while filming. The hand strap makes it easy to hold the camera while you are creating video. This is a very intuitive camera to operate right out of the box. The package comes with two batteries that slide into a compartment on the side of the camera. A 16 GB memory card is also included which allows you plenty of memory space for your first videos. There are also two batteries so you can bring a fully charged replacement battery when you're filming on the go. I like that they also included a slot reader so you can easily take the card from your camera and insert it into a USB port on your computer. This allows you to shoot videos and quickly upload them to the internet. This camera offers a lot of good video recording features at a very economical price.

title: Great Sound Quality, Lightweight, Easy to Operate
text: I've been using these headphones for a week and I can't get over the superior sound quality. They feature terrific high end frequency replication and offer a bass you can feel. I experimented briefly with the Bose music app, but I have enough apps on my phone already and this connects fine as a regular Bluetooth device. In the end, the comfort and sound quality are the most important and not the other features. Both are great on this product. These headphones have a really nice, sleek design. The ear cups swivel and can be easily adjusted to fit your head. The ear cups have what seems to be a soft leather or imitation leather padding that is comfortable and helps create a seal that blocks out external noise. You can adjust the amount of noise cancellation, so these are ideal headphones for both travel and zoning out. The headphones charge with a USB-C charging port. At this time most of my other devices require a USB Micro-B, but I'm seeing more of he C ports and cables. A charging cable is included along with an AUX cable. You also get a very nice plastic hard case that zips closed. The headphones have a minimal design with only three buttons. The only button that's labeled is the Bluetooth button. One really cool feature is that the front half of the right ear cup can recognize taps and gestures. Instead of feeling around for a tiny button, you can just double tap the ear cup to play your music or answer a call. You can adjust volume by swiping down or swiping up. The 20 hour battery life means these are always ready to play. I'm sure this set of headphones has more features than I'll ever use. The most important thing is that they are very comfortable, easily adjustable, and sound terrific. If you love music on the go, these headphones are a perfect choice.

title: Significantly Faster Internet
text: There is nothing more frustrating than having dead zones in your own home where you have poor connectivity. I got this router in anticipation of my two young girls growing into teenagers. The internet is an integral part of their educational and social life, so it's imperative to have good coverage throughout the house to reduce family stress. The system consists of a router and two satellite signal boosters that you can use to ensure great internet throughout your home. As you can see from the pictures, the router has two gigabit ethernet ports. The satellites have a power plug and a sync button. Every component is highly compact at 4.1 by 4.1 by 2.7 inches. There is also an app that allows you to have convenient control options on your phone. You also receive a 2 meter ethernet cable and three power adapters for the router and satellites. The router and satellites are easy to hook up and sync. You can place them strategically throughout your home to ensure you get great internet coverage everywhere. I always make everyone in my family use their wi-fi on their phone rather than a data plan, so by reducing poor connectivity zones this router will definitely be a long term savings. I also like the compact size and design of all three elements. This is a great system for getting the most out of your internet.

title: Fast and Portable Hard Drive
text: It's hard to see just how small this drive is from the promotional pictures. I didn't believe them when they said it was the size of a credit card, but except for the thickness, this drive is actually even smaller. This solid 500 GB solid state drive is perfect for making a secure back up for your digital photo album. I'm old school, and I don't completely trust the cloud with my most precious memories. Old fashioned hard drives are delicate with an internal drive that can scratch or break. You still have to be careful with your solid state drive, but it will last a lot longer and is much less susceptible to breaking than other drives. This drive connects to your computer with a USB drive and has a USB micro B super speed connection that hooks into the drive itself. This is a tiny, high-capacity expansion drive that is perfect for ensuring you won't lose any data.

title: Very Impressed With This Lightning Fast Computer
text: This is a very fast computer that is easy to set up and operate. The computer arrives suspended in foam packaging to ensure you get your unit in proper working order. I included a photo above to show the packaging which supports the computer and ensures all the delicate components are wrapped and protected. The unit comes with a keyboard and mouse that connect via USB cables. I found both of these accessories to be ergonomically friendly and easy to operate. The computer has a power button on the front along with a speaker jack, a headphone jack, two USB 2.0 ports, a USB 3.1 port, and a USB 3.1 type-C port. On the back there are 2 USB 2.0 ports that are used for the keyboard and mouse. There are also 4 USB 3.1 ports, an internet port, and various monitor ports. When in operation, the computer emits a blue light from the front. The computer measures 12.5 x 6.5 x 14.25 and fits conveniently on or beneath a desk. The Intel Core i7-9700 processor is lighting fast and great for playing video games or streaming movies. This is a great computer that is perfect for professionals, students, or anyone with computational needs.

title: Great, Fast, High Storage Capacity USB Drive
text: PNY has long been a leading manufacturer of reliable flash drives, and this unit is no exception. The 32 GB of storage provides you with plenty of memory space, and information can be transferred from your computer very fast. This flash drive has a superior plastic dust sleeve that protects the end of the device and never gets in the way. As you can see from the above pictures, the sleeve slides back and forth across the unit body so there is no cap to lose or spinning parts that can break. I like to bring a drive like this on vacation so I can make quick, portable backup copies of my photos. This device is highly portable, fast, and functional.

title: A Discrete Bag That Provides Plenty of Protection
text: This backpack is perfect for a student, a traveler, or anyone who wants extra protection for their laptop. The bag has a nice, comfortable back panel that cushions and supports your back while providing a protective enclosure for your valuable electronics. The straps, too, are very well padded and easily adjustable so you can be assured of a proper fit. The description says this is a 15 inch bag, but there is plenty of room in the storage space. I could use this bag for a weekend trip without any problem. There is also a simple front pouch that zips closed that could fit a couple paperbacks. The top has a zip pouch that is ideal for a cell phone or keys. Finally, there are water bottle pockets on each side, one with a zip compartment. This is a great backpack that is practical and effective, but isn't flashy and won't attract thieves. Everyone needs a backpack like this.

title: Great for a Shop or Office
text: This is one of the best power strips I've ever seen. It is large, durable and has plenty of outlets for all your office equipment, tools or appliances. I like how the outlets are separated so that there is plenty of room for bulky plugs. This strip has convenient wall mounts so you can fix it in place and create a highly efficient work station. With all the electronic devices we have now, it seems like there are never enough outlets. If you are looking for a power strip so you can recharge the batteries on your power tools, or protect your computer from a lighting strike, this is the product to choose.

title: Superior Reception
text: I have used an HD antenna instead of cable television for years. With a one time purchase price, you can eliminate the ridiculous monthly fees for cable, which results in hundreds of dollars in savings per year. I got this system as an upgrade over my previous antenna and I couldn't be happier. All you have to do is plug in the antenna, connect it to your TV, and then hang the flat end on a window or wall. The kit includes some dual sided sticky pads from 3M so you can adhere the antenna wherever you wish. I put mine high up on my window behind the curtain where it is out of sight and seems to get the best reception. You will have to do a channel scan on your TV which takes only a few minutes. After a channel scan, I found I got 3 additional channels with this antenna that I didn't get with my previous one. An antenna like this allows you to get terrific television service at a fraction of the price. Highly recommended.

title: Loud and Clear!
text: These are a really great set of Walkie Talkies. Our family does a lot of hiking, and it helps to motivate small children to go for a hike in the woods if you give them a Walkie Talkie. The second you hand them one, they sprint ahead of you to get far enough away to start talking. We had to do a road trip recently with two vehicles, and it was great to use these units to communicate between cars. Cell phones would have been an option, but these units broadcast without having to push an answer button. Also, if you are traveling through poor cell phone coverage areas, they work really well. Durable and waterproof, we found that you can get a signal from several miles away. This is a great product for camping with your family and many other physical activities.

title: I'm Very Happy with this Monitor
text: This is a terrific monitor that is going to make my work day a lot easier. First of all at 27 inches it is huge. I included a picture to show you how much bigger the monitor is than a typical laptop screen. Also, the monitor does not have the glare that is created by my laptop screen. It's like the difference between a matte finish and a glossy finish on a paperback. The glossy finish starts to tire your eyes at the end of the day, and the matte finish keeps you fresh. I'm finding I don't have to take as many eye breaks with this new monitor. Installation is easy. The stand is solid and goes together without any tools. The TV also locks into the stand with no tools and has both a vertical and a tilt adjustment. There is a set of control keys along the side that allow you to make adjustments to the picture. I turned down the brightness to try to match the screen of my laptop. It came with a VGA cable, an audio cable, and a power cable. There is a HDMI plug in the back, but no HDMI cable was included with the purchase price. Note that you have to use the button on the side of the monitor to turn it on, not the switch located next to the power cable. This is a very nice monitor.

title: Not Very Good
text: I've used this, but people say it sounds like I'm far away when I talk into it. Kind of disappointing, although my phone has been acting up lately, so maybe the problem is there. Construction, etc., seem nice and the incoming sound is fine.

title: Works Great
text: I'd lost my charging plate for my Garmin Forerunner which was annoying because it meant I thought I'd have to replace the whole watch. However, this little beauty was a super inexpensive alternative. I had the cable and the plug, so I plugged it in and it was good to go. Good replacement, it might be nice buying a couple extra just to have around.

title: Work So Far
text: These are nice, I've been trying to get earbuds to work with my kids, but they keep falling out of their ears. My kids (girls aged 5 and 3) were excited about these. They're fans of the Transformers, and these look like they're designed after Optimus Prime. Of course they fought over them at first (I was only offered one set), so I might have to get another one. So far they've held up to kid wear and tear, which is considerable. I thought the sound was pretty good for them, but the big thing is that the kids are just willing to wear them. Works so far. I received a free product in exchange for an honest review.

title: Fun Speaker
text: This is a neat little speaker. It claims to be waterproof, and I think it would handle a brief rain shower, but I doubt you'd want to throw it into a swimming pool. Still, for poolside entertainment this thing is great. The ports are covered up by a rubber cover, so I think it's about as water resistant as a speaker can be. Beneath the cover is also an on/off switch. It's a tactile switch, not a button so you don't have to sit there pressing it while counting to five or anything ridiculous. The sound of the speaker is very good for such a little item. The speaker itself is about as wide as an old VHS tape just to give you an idea of scale. There's also a flashlight on one end, which makes this a nice camping item. Recommended! I received a free sample in exchange for an honest review.

title: Works for me!
text: Very good cable. I always prefer to hook my computer directly up to a modem through an ethernet cable because the internet is faster than through wi-fi (or at least it seems so to me). Also, you don't get the occasional outages you sometimes experience with wi-fi. This is a functional cable, no faster or slower than any other cable I've owned. Works for me! I received a free sample in exchange for an honest review.

title: Clean Up Your Work Station
text: These are what you'd expect them to be, it's essentially a neoprene chunk of fabric with a zipper down the side. Lately I've been doing everything I can to move away from cables of any kind. When the apocalypse happens, people will look at the rolling balls of useless cables and wonder just what was wrong with our society. But this cable wrap makes things a little bit better. I'm constantly swapping out an audio cable, so it's nice to have that cable bundled (because the darn thing gets lost otherwise). These are attractive and functional. Good product. I received a free sample in exchange for an honest review.

title: Better than the Cable Company Router--By a bit
text: I'd been using the same router that the cable company installed when I signed my contract back in 2009. I figured that any 2016 entry level router should be a noticeable upgrade. I've had movies stall in the middle of streaming, etc. This was a quick and easy install and yes, i'm not getting as much movie stalling...but it still happens occasionally. So I'm satisfied, but not ecstatic. I was hoping to eliminate stalling completely. Still, it does seem to be better. Maybe I should have tossed in the next $50 for the better version...I'll keep that in mind for when 2022 rolls around and it's time to upgrade again. Unit looks really cool.

title: Works as Voice Recorder and MP3 Player
text: For $19 this is a pretty solid deal when you consider that the voice recorder can also be used as a MP3 player. There is a little speaker down at the base, and when the volume is at full blast this little guy is surprisingly loud. My only issue is that the controls are a little tricky to work out. This is necessitated by the fact that this is a slim, tiny device (It's a little bigger than one of those old Kingston USB drives), so there's not that much space to put controls on the thing. For volume, you have a push a button, then wait for the volume indicator to flash, before toggling another button. While the MP3 player was playing at full blast, this was a little distressing...but I eventually figured it out. The voice recorder works well too. In that case, the controls are easy, you just depress a switch above the power button and it starts to record. Playback is a little tougher, but when you plug this into your computer (USB cable included), it's easy to download the voice notes. I had a little more trouble loading up MP3s as you couldn't put them in a folder. You have to copy and paste the actual MP3 files and paste them into the Proster folder that indicates the device. When I played the voice notes stored on the device, there was a note from the factory in what I assume was China. It was just a few second sample of some ladies chatting in a work place, but I found that kind of interesting. This would be a good reorder to bring to meetings with people you don't trust as it records better than the voice recorder on your cell phone and it's easier to hide. Kind of a nice piece of equipment. I anticipate I'll use it running since I don't like earbuds and this blasts a lot of volume.

title: Essentially it's a $50 Computer
text: I got this on a black friday deal and have loved it so far. Essentially this is a little computer. You can connect the WI-Fi to your house link and use a word processor on Google docs. If you connect a bluetooth keyboard, you've got a laptop. I don't know why people would spend hundreds of dollars getting a laptop (or why school districts go with ipads) when you can get this for under $50. At this price, you can't afford not to have one (because when the kids demand to get on your tablet, they can beat on this instead of the $800 work issued device they want). Also, if you haven't gone kindle, you need to know that there are thousands of books available for free. This little device will keep you entertained for a long time.

title: All the Storage Space You Need
text: This is great! I bought one for my wife and liked it so much I bought another for myself. I use a Blackberry and she has a Samsung, so both of our devices have memory slots allowing us to expand our memory for under $10. This is why we stay away from Apple. 32GB is a ton of space for videos and photos. The only downside is you have to remember to download your photos every now and then (you're never running out of space so there's no incentive). You wouldn't want to get into a position where you lose your phone and it has your only copy of baby pictures for the last 10 years. However, another positive thing is that even if you drop your phone into a lake, you can still fish it out and extract the photos from the card (solid state memory). Very nice product. A couple of the other reviewers mentioned that they purchased this item from secondary sellers and got a knock-off. I purchased from Amazon and got exactly the item listed.

title: Synch your Phone With your Car Audio System
text: This is a very nice product. I spend a lot of my time listening to podcasts while I do a 1.5 hr drive to work. In the past, I used to just sit my telephone in a cradle and turn the volume up, but at freeway speeds the ambient noise was enough to make it hard to hear the sound coming from the phone's speaker. This product charges in your cigarette lighter and allows you to connect your phone to the car radio via bluetooth. You then have to pick a radio station that is not carrying a broadcast and set the control on the bluetooth FM to the same station. All of this sounds like a lot while I'm typing it out, but it goes quickly. However, I do highly recommend that you make sure the radio is set up correctly before you start driving. There are enough accidents caused by texting, and this does represent another potential driving distraction. If you set this item up while parked, it is very useful, but if you try to do it on the roll, then it could be dangerous...fair warning. Once you have your phone connected to your car speaker system you can listen to your own music, podcasts, etc. It is a little bit of a problem when somebody calls you, however, because the device doesn't automatically un-pair when there is a call. I found I usually had to call people back if I got a phone call. Not a huge issue really. There is also a mini flash card slot on this device so you could play your music directly from that. Really a good product. I received a complimentary sample in exchange for an honest review.

title: Don't Waste Your Money
text: Mine flat out didn't work. When I turned it on, the load up time was appallingly slow. So I let it charge overnight to see if that helped things (didn't). I plugged it in and downloaded songs, only to have them not turn up on the play menu. A podcast I downloaded played for about 15 seconds and then turned to static. Even the font on the display screen seems cheaply done (it reminded me of what you found on handheld video games in the 80s). Honestly, by the time I was done messing with this thing for a couple hours, I wondered if the whole point of the product was to download some malware on your computer. Not a good item.

title: Awesome Storage Capacity in a Tiny Package
text: I brought this with me to Peru in order to make a quick back-up of all the photos I'd taken (I didn't want to have the whole trip erased...or lost because my baggage got stolen). It was a big comfort to be able to throw this flash drive in my pocket and know I'd have it when I returned home. 128 GB is plenty of space to store all your images on a trip like this. You can also download all your photos just to clear out your memory cards. The download only takes a minute (depending on your computer). It's amazing how far these mini storage devices have become. I remember when we were psyched about having 126 MB on a flash drive!

title: Functional and Elegant
text: This is an easy to operate stand that you can have operational minutes after pulling it out of the box. Everything is quite intuitive. Your devices are held into the clips via springs, and the clamp is fixed to the table through a screw locking system (note: you don't screw anything into your desk, the stand itself screws tight). I have already placed this on several surfaces and the stand doesn't leave any scratches or other markings. The head of the stand is adjustable so you can swing your mobile or tablet around to various angles. The head is a bit stiff, but this is necessary so that the stand doesn't move once it has been put into position. Frankly, I like this because once you get into the habit of placing your phone in the stand, you never lose it.

title: Saves me Money
text: I got this for use at one of the few remaining drive-in theaters in the state of Wisconsin. I hook it up to a larger speaker that I connect to my cell phone with bluetooth. The radio works great, and this helps save money since I'm not using my data plan on my phone to access a radio station through an app. The speaker on this radio is fairly effective for use in a very small room, but it works better if you hook it up to a larger speaker through the audio jack.

title: Quick Computer Back up
text: I've had great luck with Toshiba products and this one is no different. I used it to back up my hard drive. I don't subscribe to a cloud service, instead, I periodically purchase an external hard drive and do a back up, then I store the hard drive away from my computer. I don't like to keep my back up plugged into my computer because a power surge might blow out both the computer and the back up. At the price, it's good for peace of mind to just buy one of these, back up your computer, and then store the item in a safe deposit box (that's probably cheaper than paying $7 a month for a cloud service). You have all the pictures of your kids throughout your life on your computer, and this is the solution that most appeals to me. Love that they're so cheap these days.

title: What I was looking for
text: I picked up a factory refurbished unit and I'm satisfied. I was looking for a point and shoot camera that didn't have an extending lens. I wanted something that I could stick in the pocket of my bicycle jersey and pull out without having to worry about destroying the camera. I did wreck one of my old cell phones by sticking it in my jersey pocket, so the waterproof component of this camera was ideal. I paid approximately $100 for this, and it takes decent pictures. Like I mentioned before, the lens doesn't extend, so you have to be pretty close to your subject, but the images are good enough that you can use enhancement software to create the image you want from the raw material. It's not a DSLR, but this is a good accessory camera to bring along. It slips easily into your pocket and can take a bit of a beating. I don't intend to use this for underwater shooting, so I haven't tested it for that. If it rains on me while cycling, I'm confident the camera can take it. I'm satisfied.

title: Well Made but Not Practical
