text: I picked this up for a trip to Peru, but it's so unwieldy I didn't end up using it. You're better off just getting a large ziplog bag and cutting open the end opposite the top. I resorted to the ziplock bag method and found it easier. That being said, the item itself is well made and effective enough, it just didn't strike me as very practical.

title: Perfect!
text: I've used this backpack on two trips to Peru for the Inca Trail. It's the perfect item, large enough to hold your camera, some extra clothing, and a water bladder, but not so big to become uncomfortably heavy. I always pack light, and I wouldn't want more than this if I were planning on a 20 mile hike. Be aware that the camera padding takes up about half of the bag (you want your camera to be protected, so this isn't a complaint). After several years, mine shows very little wear (and I've been rough on it). Very good product!

title: Works Great and Less Expensive than the Name Brand Bulb
text: This worked just as well as the Viewsonic lamp that came with the unit, and was significantly cheaper than the viewsonic replacement.

title: Constant static so you have to turn them off when not in use...
text: I get constant static with these even when they're not in use so I tried plugging them into various places/ ports to see if anything changed it and nothing worked! The colors/modes are really cool, the sound quality is decent, the speakers get plenty loud, they feel solid, and look amazing! But that static issue is a deal breaker with me, I have to turn the speakers off when not in use and it's just inconvenient to have to do. These will probably be going in the trash sadly.

title: Better than a pair of $200 bose earbuds!!
text: I have reviewed multiple name brand earbuds and wasn't impressed by a single one of them! I now have a pile of earbuds that I hate and never use. I came across these and figured I'd try them for some reason and instantly was blown away by the clarity of phone calls with it! I have a phone that costs over $1,000 and these headphones microphones and sound are many times better than my phones built in ones! I talked to someone about it and was truly impressed for the price point and they weren't surprised and poitned out that this is a legit company that makes a lot of high end electronics. They made a bunch of those expensive tape decks/ sound systems back in the day that cost thousands of dollars! Those things still work after all these years which is a testament to this company's quality. I absolutely stand behind these earbuds and even told some friends they need to grab a set!

title: Truly impressed with this and at that price point, will be buying more!!
text: I installed this over a week ago and have been using it daily... I looked up the price today so I can comment on it's "value" and I am genuinely surprised at how cheap it is! I've had cameras over $100 that didn't perform half as good as this! To set it up, all you have to do is download their app, make a login, and have the camera scan the QR code in the app and it's setup! Super quick and painless! And putting the camera up on the porch consisted of drilling 4 screws in so that was super easy! Comes with a template to help you mount it perfectly straight or whatever but I didn't use that and it still looks good. Functionality- this thing spins all the way left and right (wont spin in circles but it does reach all the way to each side.) Then it's range of looking up and down is really good too. I posted this on a porch post out front and I can turn the camera to the left and look down to see when Amazon delivers my packages now! Truly impressive the coverage this one camera has! Night vision has like 3 different modes- one of them I think it keeps the spotlight on (which is BRIGHT) and I can see my car in full color/crystal clear from a few feet away! Another mode is just black and white with the IR lights on. And the other mode is black and white but it switches the spot light on and goes to full color when it sense motion. I need to see if it has a sensitivity setting because the on bit of annoyances is that as is- it catches motion of bugs and everything under the sun so I look at my phone and have 30 alerts at any given time from the camera! Hopefully I can fix that but even if not, I am happy with the camera for the price point! Picture- it auto starts off in standard def but you click that icon and it switches it to HD which is MUCH clearer!! Overall I'm truly amazed by this and will be buying a few more to cover my current house and the house we're remodeling. I normally go with another company's cams but this one is far more impressive and I'm a convert for sure!

title: Great stickers
text: Great variety while sticking to it's theme. I really liked these stickers, they were a good size and none were missing or damaged/miscut. I like just how many different themes you can get from this company, and they are all so unique. No repeats. The stickers themselves were good quality, being well printed and cut.

title: Great for the shower but not a great all around speaker outside the shower...
text: So for the shower- this things great! But outside the shower I'm just not impressed with this. I've reviewed several $20 ish price range bluetooth speakers and each of them has a little more bass and oomph than this one. It's pretty weak for what it is, even my Echo dot puts out more sound. That being said, this does get decently loud and is just fine for the shower! I used the attached suction and put it in my shower and it was great not having to reach outside the shower and touch my phone with wet hands to skip songs or commercials on youtoube. Some things I've noticed on youtube though- I'll click the next button when it has a ad up and I can skip it. It'll then just send me to the next song as well and I'll have to hit the back button if I want to return to my original song. The ad will still be out of the way at this point so it WORKS for this, just kinda adds one more step. Just a minor annoyance but still so much better than having youtube take advantage of me being in the shower and cramming 2 to 3 ads at me at once since I often don't wanna reach outta the shower to hit skip every couople of minutes. Battery lifes decent. For the price, it's not bad at all. Again, I'd really just use this for the shower. Maybe outside around a pool even... But if you're not using it for the waterproof feature, I'd skip it- the sound quality isn't impressive at all.

title: Good sturdy little suction cup holder!
text: I don't actually have the dashcam this goes to but with a little dremel work I trimmed this one to fit my dashcam and it holds it perfectly! Very sturdy smaller mount that seems well made and sticks to the window well. Be sure to take something like a bottle of rubbing alcohol and something like a paper towel to the spot you'll be sticking it to- these suctions don't work at all on windows that are dirty or have something on them. It sticks perfectly on my clean window and does it's job!

title: Great value
text: Very cute stickers. I love that there are lots of different styles of art too. Definitely something for every animal lover in this pack. And there are so many, I definitely have lots extra to give away to friends. These stickers were really nice quality, and a good size as well.

title: This is the fan you need!!!
text: I recently got a similar one like this but the 2nd fan was a light. It was neat but the battery life didn't last long enough and when charging you could only use low mode. SO I get this and find out today that you can kick it into full speed while it's charging! Charge time doesn't take that long either. Both fans pump a really good amount of air out and they work great for when I've been moving around doing things that overheat me. These cool me down quickly! I often get migraines and somehow find the cool air on the top of my head feels good so I have one of the fans from this pointed at the top of my head and it does a great job keeping it nice and cool!

title: Literally says in the title that it includes the ring
text: I'm attaching a screenshot of the current listing in case the listing gets changed but currently it says includes metal ring (mine did NOT include it.) This things worthless for me without that ring as my tablet certainly didn't come with one. The stand itself seems cheap. I just threw it in the trash since I have no use for the thing now.

title: NEARLY perfect! The volume keys are kinda hard to press because they don't stick out far.
text: I have to kind of dig my nail into the volume key pretty much to get them to work as they're very flat. Other than that- the rest of the buttons work flawlessly and this is pretty much a clone of the original remote but with a few flatter buttons. The wheel and air mouse works perfectly. Didn't have to do any programming with my 70 inch LG 70UN7370PUC tv, it just paired with it after a couple tries and was ready to go! Considering the features on this remote, I think the price is pretty good. The volume buttons aren't a deal breaker, just could be a little more pronounced so they're easier to press is all.

title: Only thing premium here is the price point
text: These don't have a great fit and the audio level/quality isn't great. For the $100 price point, I'd 100% feel ripped off. These perform more like some $20-30 headphones. The colors are cute but it ends there really.

title: Decent quality dash cam. Has to be slid into it's holder thing to work...
text: I got this thinking I could possibly just hang it on a lanyard as a body cam as it's much cheaper and seemingly better quality than most body cams out there. I saw it has the little eyelet on it and figured it'd be easy to hang from my neck but sadly this won't function without being slid into it's base part. It makes it a bit bulky to carry for what I needed. Not impossible but I wish there was an option to use it without the base part it slides into. If you want to carry it with you- you'll pretty much have to get an action cam mount and attach this to it. All of that being said, the picture is pretty good on this, setup was easy, I can make out car tag numbers as they go by so it focuses pretty well. No other complaints on it other than it has to be in it's thing to work, other than that it's perfect and I love it!

title: Really cool projector but you really need to mount it for your safety
text: This thing is amazing and produces a really cool image but if you're holding it in your hand, the fan is fast and powerful enough that it's scary. I think it'd really hurt if you got your hand in it so I don't think this is a good toy for small kids who don't know how to be safe around things. I'm afraid it might break a small hand if one got caught in this, it truly is powerful! That being said, it makes a great image and is meant to be mounted, not held. Keep that in mind and this thing is perfect!

title: Easy to setup and use
text: This camera was easy to install since you don't run power to it. It's easy to use the app. Picture quality is fairly decent. No real complaints on this at all. Works great for places where electricity is hard to run there.

title: Plug n play, very easy to use for a first timer!
text: The price of these seems bloated and seems like these should be a bit less but other than that, I love these! If one was on a budget then I suppose VR goggles you just slide your phone into would give you the same effect as these. These don't take up much space though and would be great for something like an airplane instead of having to have a giant laptop out the whole time and your neighbor judging you for watching a horror movie on the plane. I get bored easily and even a 2 or 3 hour flight could be made so much better by watching a movie so these little glasses are my best friend! You can plug the usb c into your phone and into these and you get instant mirroring without any apps even! I went to some VR videos and you can look up and down and turn around in a room and see all around it- it's really neat! Honestly I don't know the full potential to use these for gaming or whatever but for streaming video, they work great and have a great picture! I've even used them in bed and they light up the room a little less than my phone screen so don't disturb my boyfriend as much. If you're worried about someone seeing what you're watching from the front (they used see thru lenses for some reason)- I suppose you could put some sort of darkening tent or something on the outside and it'd keep people from seeing what you are watching. I was truly blown away at how quickly I got these up and going without having read any instructions or having ever had anything like this previously. I do absolutely love them but again- the price point for what they are seems a bit insane.

title: Feel kinda ripped off for the price point honestly, smaller speakers put out more sound than this
text: I have a handful of off brand cylinder shaped bluetooth speakers that put off a good amount of sound and even the cheap ones have a decent amount of bass to them. This didn't seem to put out nearly as much sound or bass as my smaller cheaper speakers that are in the $50 price point. I don't recommend this one at all, save your money and buy a cheapo bluetooth speaker! I think half of the problem is the design of this one, it just has small sections where it lets sound out rather than letting the sound out all around it. It's just strange honestly. I wanted to love it but I'm not impressed at all.

title: Great way to make your own smart house or add computers around the house or shop easily
text: I have a few of these little things around so I can have one in my workout room, one in my wood shop, kitchen, living room- I just put them everywhere so I always have a computer handy without lugging a laptop around. Might not make sense to some but that's my reason for loving these little things- it makes it affordable to put multiple computers in the house. Functionality wise- this works really well and doesn't have any lag when streaming tv or anything like that. It's a great little computer for streaming/ surfing the net. It obviously doesn't have the requirements for hardcore online gaming but for other basic uses- it pretty much does it all! Love this little computer!

title: Decent for the price, some buttons you have to press more than once
text: This works ok for the price point. When typing on the keyboard a name of a movie to search, it often skips letters and I have to push them more than once. Even with that it's still a time saver so I'm not mad. Decent budget remote.

title: Nice system, comes with everything you need but a monitor!
text: This is a decently put-together system and comes with all the cords, dvr (with hard drive), 4 cameras (you can add 4 more cameras on, can even be another brand- just has to have the same connections), and it has a mouse. All you need is a monitor and it gives you the option to connect an old school vga monitor or an hdmi one. You can often find flat panel monitors at thrift shops or the marketplace super cheap if you're trying to stick with a budget. Setup was super easy, each camera comes with a sticker template to put onto the surface so you can line it up how you want and drill any necessary holes for the cables and such. The system is pretty plug n play, easy to setup. The cameras have like a very sturdy steel metal housing which is very nice. One complaint is that like many- they put it together on the end and the end piece (that's black) is a separate/ joined together piece. So that has the ability to open the camera up to moisture/ water leaking in. Sadly most cameras have this in some form or fashion. Ways to make your camera last longer would be to install them under a awning if you have one or if you are installing near a garage, install it in the recessed part of your garage door so it acts as a mini awning for the camera. Beware of leaky gutters outside that drip or pour a lot of water- that'll ruin about any of these cameras quick. You COULD put a small bead of silicone or even some clear outdoor rated tape along the seam on the cameras to help keep moisture out but it's something you'd have to keep up with and replace as necessary- sadly no tape or silicone will provide a permanent seal and nothing will in the elements outside. Don't be deterred by this and go with a different brand, sadly this is a flaw of all outdoor cameras I've ever tested. Just beware and plan accordingly to keep them lasting as long as possible. That being said, I love the sturdy steel housing on these cameras. The picture they provide is crisp and clear- sooo much better than any of those surveillance pictures you see that people post online asking if you've seen this person (and you can't really see them because it's terrible quality.) This system gives you a pretty clear picture and for the price point, I'm very impressed! Even it's night vision is very usable and nice. I'll be looking for some pan/tilt cameras to try and hook into this system so I can utilize all 8 slots on it. A lot of people are fine with 4 cameras of course, I just like to be extra. I also love to be able to follow someone on camera and these cameras are fixed so you can't really turn them to look at people so I'd recommend adding pan/tilt cameras to this system. The dvr drive is very lightweight and it records your video directly to it and you can access it from the drive directly with a monitor or you can use their app and access it thru your phone from anywhere. You can also view live streams from anywhere to check on your house, pets, kids, etc. The one thing I've got to say is just like with any system- if you're a cheapskate and don't pay for the subscription service, just beware that you really need to hide your dvr somewhere and at the same time allow for ventilation so it won't overheat. (don't stuff it in a small enclosed space) You could put it in a sturdy safe and mount that to a wall or floor but heat is still an issue, you'd need to drill or cut out some ventilation holes in the top (since heat rises) and that will allow heat to escape from the safe so it doesn't overheat your dvr. Overall for less than a $200 price point, I am very happy and impressed with what you get and the quality of the picture it provides. Highly recommend this system.

title: Works- not bad for the price at all!
text: So it's cheaper and when you record audio- it's not going to be crystal clear and you'll hear some static probably. It's clear enough that you can make out what it's saying without difficulty though. For the price point, I honestly can't complain. The remote works perfectly, it was easy to record my own audio, and the sensor works well. Speaker gets plenty loud and has adjustable volume which is nice. If you're planning on using this as a prank thing- FYI it has a little red light that stays on even when it's turned off. (that ones kind of dim though) But when it's tripped by motion- it has like four bright led lights on it that flash as the audio goes off so unless you knew how to open this up and remove those or you maybe painted the red face of this to cover the leds, it's gonna not work so well to be a hidden prank box.

title: Easy setup, great speeds!
text: My desktop was being laggy on the internet and I've tried EVERYTHING but a new internet card. I previously had a cat 5 cable running from my router from across the house and the cords still in perfect shape so I suspect it was my internet card on the computer and grabbed this tp link wireless thing. I plugged it in and ran it's driver and really quickly my computer showed a "Wi-Fi 2" option and said TP Link on that so I chose that option and now my internet is running much more smoothly! I think it's silly that a wireless thing is running better than a cat 5 cable connection but it absolutely is! I have gigabit internet and this thing gets the internet to my computer at the same speeds as the cable did which is really good! Very happy with this! It's smaller too so doesn't take up much space.

title: Plug n play and works well!
text: I've had some really expensive web cams but love this brand so figured I'd try this one out. For the price point, I'm very impressed! I love the physical privacy shutter in the end you can close so you know no one's watching you when you're not using it. The picture it produces is very clear and usable. Highly recommend this if this is your price range! There are some higher end cameras that will give you 4k and do a lot more but for the typical person, this webcam is more than enough!

title: Neat low profile mouse, works well! USB thing is a little too snug though...
text: I'm using this with the Acer Vero laptop and it works perfectly. The track wheel works pretty well but it's kind of like driving an old truck with very loose-feeling steering. It works, it just spins fairly freely so it feels strange at first. I like it though! The optical on this works well, I'm using my laptop's sleeve as a mouse pad and it works great! Taking away one star because the usb dongle on this has WAY too tight of a fit! I can't even get it into one of the laptop's usb ports and it's a matching branded Acer Vero laptop, same color and everything! But I put it in a port on the left side and had to nudge it in a bit harder than anything else and it went in. I tested it in various other usb ports around my house and in ALL of them it's a very snug fit and in some, it's hard to push it in. The dongle itself isn't bent or anything so the only thing I can think of is poor design. Other than the dongle issue, this is one of my favorite wireless mice I've had! It has a low profile and feels very natural in my hand. I would just use the trackpad on the laptop but it doesn't have physical click buttons, you have to push the trackpad down in the corners to click- I really don't like that. So this mouse fixes that for me.

title: Easy to assemble and really nice!! You'll need power bank for selfie ring
text: [[VIDEOID:1f63ad9bf831df9a7540879ecc1d7d0c]] I've attached a video showing what it looks like in operation. The ring light is very bright and works great (have it off in the video as my power bank died) This needs a power bank for the selfie ring, it's not included. Set-up was super easy, screwed in the feet on the bottom - you can raise or lower each of them to level the machine. The led strip was easy to stick on and looks nice. Then you'll slide the fork part into the side and secure it with two screw things that are already attached. Then you screw on the stick that holds the selfie ring on top of that. I installed a couple of the phone holders, I put my power bank in one of the slots and connected the selfie ring light. Plugged the power into the base and plugged the leds in. That's when I powered it up and got it going like you can see in the video. The part that surprised me most is the gears on this are made of metal, not cheap plastic. Looking in my picture, you can see the huge silver metal gear, this machine wasn't made cheaply at all! Overall, this was super easy to set up and use, I'm very happy about it! Great quality and lots of fun! Highly recommend this!

title: EASY to setup, very professional quality screen!!
text: FYI this thing is like 7 1/2 feet from side to side on the metal frame... It's BIG. It's not overly heavy, I have a bad back and can lift it with ease. It's very easy to setup and it's absolutely a professional quality screen that I could see people using for a business meeting. It could be portable and transport fairly easy but If you have a regular car with no folding seats that let you use the trunk, I dunno if this would fit in your car so easily. Lucky for me I have a hatchback and it'll go in there easily. The picture quality on this is really nice, it doesn't wash out like the cheap cloth ones when the light goes thru them. You COULD use it outside but I wouldn't do so unless the air was completely still or you have a way to anchor it somehow. If I were putting it next to a building, you might put some sort of hook on your building that you could then tie a rope to and tie it to this, like a tv's strap to keep them from tipping. Otherwise, if it's in the middle of an open area you could TRY to tie rope or paracord to it and stake it down. I'd try a "V" shape and do two stakes in front attached to the bottom of the tripod and then on the back I might attach the rope halfway up the pole and stake those two down behind it. Then just be careful that no one trips over the cord. (use brightly colored rope/ cord) This is the best projector screen I've come across! For the price, it's completely worth it! I think because of the tripod legs that a lot of people wouldn't wanna keep this up full time in their house, for that you could just attach one to the wall possibly. That being said- the tripod legs don't actually stick out too far so they don't pose a huge tripping hazard.

title: Nice laptop but read my review first-
text: SO this has an IPS monitor which gives you higher definition and clarity than an LED monitor. But also it uses more energy and these types of monitors are known for heating up and overheating which can cause premature failure. To further add to this issue, some genius put its heat fan pointed RIGHT at the front of the monitor. I've never seen this in a laptop and don't understand why they couldn't vent it out the side or even reposition the monitor slightly so they could vent the heat out the back. I'm really hoping that the heat blowing onto the monitor that's already known for heat issues isn't gonna be an issue. Within a few short minutes of regular browsing, its fan is blowing non-stop and the bottom part of the actual computer screen is getting hot because of the exhaust fan. Other than the screen and heat issue, the laptop seems to be nicely made. It only took a couple of minutes to setup and streams videos/ surfs the net flawlessly when paired with my gigabit internet. It's not slow at all- loads programs quickly and loads web pages quickly. I think it's a good computer overall and they're on the right track with this one. It looks really cool and runs great! The thing that I love about it's finish is it's not glossy- those always scratch up and look junky quickly. The finish on this one will stay looking great for years I'm sure!

title: Great quality cord, works perfectly!

title: Complete garbage. Barely booted up from the get go and apps close non stop.

When I get a chance, I'll call back and try yet again to get them to figure out what's going on. I can say I know it's not my internet, the internet was easy to connect. title: Super thin, lightweight, easy to see writing, love it!
text: This writing tablet is very large in size which I LOVE, very thin, very lightweight. Nothing but happy with this! The writing shows up as bright green, almost neon looking! Very easy to read the writing. It has a sliding lock function that holds in place well so you don't accidentally erase your notes/ drawings. The erase button works just fine. Very easy to use, I love this thing! The battery compartment is on the back and takes one little screw so it's not hard to access at all. Overall this is just a great writing tablet! title: Pretty good photo frame, super easy to use! Speakers are horrible and bad viewing angles.
text: Very easy to use this- I set it up in like a minute without even reading the instructions thanks to the on screen prompts. It was very painless. Picture quality is so so- it's decent looking but basically, you have to be standing somewhere in front of it to see full color- the image and color is distorted if you look at it from the side or any other angle. But other than that- it does look pretty good and the picture is very usable and nice looking. Sound- it calls the speakers "loud speakers" but some videos I can BARELY hear sound, others I can hear it if everything around me is quiet and that's with the frame's volume turned up to max! Nothing "loud" about this and sadly it doesn't have bluetooth or amy sound output. I guess if you want sound, your best bet is the play music with some other device along with this. Overall this is a fairly nice, easy-to-use frame. I loaded pictures and videos on it with ease. The speakers need major improvement. The only other complaint is the price point but these frames all seem to be higher priced than a tv which seems silly. You can get a 24 inch tv with a usb slot cheaper than this 15" screen and it'd probably have better picture. For the price, It should have much better viewing angles/ better video quality.

title: Amazing little speakers! Get really loud, extremely clear audio!
text: These little speakers are a bit heavy because of the wood so they won't topple over like light speakers. The sound quality is phenomenal, VERY good sound. Plenty of bass and boom from them too! I have them hooked up to my jukebox and they truly upgraded my listening experience! The remote and Bluetooth functions all work perfectly! Overall these are fantastic speakers and for the price point, I'm pretty surprised!! Didn't expect to love them this much!

title: Nearly flawless! Types very well! Holds a flawless connection to the computer, no cutting out!
text: I'm a very fast typist so get angry when a keyboard can't keep up and quite often- a cordless keyboard can't keep up with fast-paced typing! This one can! I was very impressed by that and the fact that typing on it feels pretty natural! The bad is that everything on the right is kind of jumbled together and there's no space around the arrows or enter key. Those keys also double as the page up and page down keys and they do work but the page scrolling that it gives is kind of jerky if you will. It jerks as it scrolls and it scrolls SLOWLY. I work from my pc and often I need to search thru hundreds of pages in a short amount of time. The included mouse works well but it's not great to scroll thru a lot of documents and my hand gets tired having to drag and drop the bar on the right... SO because of this sadly, I've gone back to my old keyboard which has the typical page up and down and it flawlessly scrolls up and down on a page VERY fast and without it jerking around while doing it. To some this might not matter and in that case- if you don't use the page up and down key then this keyboard is PERFECT. As I said the typing is natural. Very silent typing too which I LOVE. The mouse works fairly well. I do a lot of work in bed so I use my sheet as a mousepad, the mouse has an issue with that sometimes and it's hard to get it to do what I want. I have noticed if I grab literally anything from a magazine to a pillow- it'll work as a mousepad though. Aside from that the mouse is great and works as it should! Battery life- I've had the same set of cheap batteries in the keyboard and mouse for a week, they automatically shut off when not in use- no need to flip a switch! They seem very easy going on batteries because I use my computer for hours each day and after a month on some cheap batteries- that's impressive! Wireless connectivity: I'm actually IMPRESSED. I have a pile of terrible wireless keyboards and as far as name brands go- Logitech has cornered the market on budget wireless keyboards it seems. That being said- I've yet to find a logitech keyboard that will keep a connection! They cut out non stop and miss key presses, it just makes the keyboards unusable! So I have a pile of their junk I need to donate... I've tried many other off brands and such and they all have the same issue, they cut out on and off and irritate me. This one triumphs over the others because the keyboard doesn't mess key presses even at a fast speed and that's certainly something! At this price point, this set is 100% worth it! I think you'll be very impressed unless you need to use the page up and down buttons a lot! A

title: HUGE screen, snapping fabric on was a bit of a nightmare and not a one person job
text: Putting the frame together was pretty easy. It's aluminum so it's lightweight but it's very thick aluminum so it'll hold up just fine! I eventually had to call a couple of the other campers in the group over and they helped hold it together as I snapped the rest of it. Once it was all snapped together it was pretty sturdy and looks amazing! Picture quality on this is terrific- I love it! You can then get another person to help carry it to the area in the grass or whatever that you want it in and stake it down if need be. It stands up great on it's own but if you have wind coming you'll wanna stake it. Overall I'm happy with this! Very large and amazing!

I did a lot of research a while back before buying rechargeables to put into my expensive electronics and EBL is listed as one of the top budget rechargeable batteries so I grabbed several quite a while back and regular batteries would have died and started leaking in this amount of time but the EBL batteries just need a recharging and I've not had a single one leak or a single dud!

title: Pretty decent headphones! Great for their price range!
text: These fit well and feel good on my head. I love that they're wireless and I am no longer bound to cords. They connect and stay connected to my computer's bluetooth, my phone, my tablet, and my tv with no problem. Audio is great for all of these devices from music to television, audio is all very clear! Noise cancellation works great on these, I love to put them on sometimes just to drown out any noise and clear my head. The bass on these is fair, it's not as booming as some more expensive headphones but it has a fair amount. Personally I don't want a lot of bass in my ears as too much of that can be bad for your hearing. These are the most premium headphones I've owned and I love them! If you compare these to really high end headphones- you'll be disappointed all around. But if you look at the price point and what you get- you'll treasure these. For the price point you can't beat these in my opinion!

title: Great camera housing
